source.text: וַיִּקְרָ֣א מֹשֶׁה֮ אֶל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם שְׁמַ֤ע יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־הַחֻקִּ֣ים וְאֶת־הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י דֹּבֵ֥ר בְּאָזְנֵיכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם וּלְמַדְתֶּ֣ם אֹתָ֔ם וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֖ם לַעֲשֹׂתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And called Moses to all Israel and said to them, hear, Israel, the statutes and the judgments which I [am] speaking in your ears the day, and you shall learn them and you shall keep to do them.

en.L: And Moses called to all Israel and said to them, "Hear, Israel, the statutes and the judgments that I [am] speaking in your ears today, and you shall learn them and take care to do them.
en.B: Moses summoned all Israel and said to them, "Hear, Israel, the statutes and rulings that I am announcing to you today. Learn them and be careful to do them.
en.R: Moses called all the people of Israel together and said to them, "Listen, Israel! Today I am telling you the laws and rules. Learn them and make sure you obey them.

es.L: Y Moisés llamó a todo Israel y les dijo: «Escucha, Israel, los estatutos y los juicios que yo pronuncio hoy a {{plural_you:sus oídos|vuestros oídos}}, y los {{plural_you:aprenderán|aprenderéis}} y {{plural_you:cuidarán|cuidaréis}} de ponerlos por obra.
es.B: Moisés convocó a todo Israel y les dijo: «Escucha, Israel, los estatutos y las normas que hoy {{plural_you:les|os}} proclamo. {{plural_you:Apréndanlos|Aprendedlos}} y {{plural_you:procuren|procurad}} cumplirlos.
es.R: Moisés reunió a todo el pueblo de Israel y les dijo: «¡Escucha, Israel! Hoy {{plural_you:les|os}} digo las leyes y las normas. {{plural_you:Apréndanlas|Aprendedlas}} y {{plural_you:asegúrense|aseguraos}} de obedecerlas.

fr.L: Et Moïse appela tout Israël et leur dit : « Écoute, Israël, les prescriptions et les jugements que je prononce à vos oreilles aujourd’hui ; vous les apprendrez et vous veillerez à les pratiquer.
fr.B: Moïse convoqua tout Israël et leur dit : « Écoute, Israël, les prescriptions et les règles que je vous annonce aujourd’hui. Apprenez-les et veillez à les mettre en pratique.
fr.R: Moïse a rassemblé tout le peuple d’Israël et lui a dit : « Écoute, Israël ! Aujourd’hui, je vous fais connaître les lois et les règles. Apprenez-les et faites bien attention à leur obéir.

am.L: ሙሴም እስራኤልን ሁሉ ጠራ፤ እንዲህም አላቸው፦ «እስራኤል ሆይ፣ ዛሬ በጆሯችሁ የምናገረውን ሥርዓቶችና ፍርዶች ስማ፤ ትማሯቸዋላችሁ፤ ልታደርጓቸውም ትጠነቀቃላችሁ።

decisions.choice: and said to them: the start of Moses' second speech
decisions.reason: A short narrative line introduces Moses' words, which begin with "Hear, Israel" and run without a break to 26:19. The first speech ended at 4:40, and 4:44-49 described the setting. This second speech holds the ten words (verses 6-21) and the laws of chapters 12-26.

decisions.choice: statutes and judgments: the laws and the rulings Moses is about to teach
decisions.reason: The pair names the whole body of law as fixed rules (statutes) and decisions for cases (judgments), as in 4:1, 5 and 4:45. Verse 31 adds "the commandment" and says Moses received all of it from God at Horeb.

decisions.choice: speaking in your ears: speaking to you directly, so that you hear it
decisions.reason: To speak "in someone's ears" is to say it aloud in their hearing (31:28, 30; Genesis 23:13). Moses stresses that the people hear it from him in person today.

decisions.choice: learn them and keep them, to do them: hearing leads to learning, and learning to doing
decisions.reason: The three verbs form a chain that runs through Deuteronomy: hear, learn, keep, do (4:1, 10; 6:1-3; 31:12). "Keep" means to watch over, take care, and with "to do" it means to be careful to carry the laws out.

decisions.choice: Listen, Israel!
decisions.reason: Readable uses the everyday word "listen" here. The same call opens 6:4, where every level keeps "Hear, Israel".

decisions.choice: "Escucha" (singular), then plural forms ("{{plural_you:aprenderán|aprenderéis}}")
decisions.reason: The Hebrew calls Israel as one and goes on in the plural; Spanish follows the Hebrew number, as throughout Deuteronomy.

decisions.choice: the narrator's line in the passé simple at Literal and Balanced ("appela", "convoqua", "dit") and the passé composé at Readable ("a rassemblé", "a dit"); Moses' speech in the tenses of speech
decisions.reason: As set for Deuteronomy at 1:1. Only this opening line is narration; from "Écoute, Israël" on, Moses speaks, and his retelling of Horeb is in the passé composé at every level.

decisions.choice: "Écoute" (singular), then "vous" (plural)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew calls Israel as one ("hear" is singular) and goes on in the plural ("your ears", "you will learn"). French follows the Hebrew number, as throughout Deuteronomy.

decisions.choice: "Sikia" (L, B), "Sikiliza" (R), singular; then plural ("mtajifunza", "jifunzeni")
decisions.reason: The Hebrew calls Israel as one and goes on in the plural; Swahili follows the Hebrew number. "Sikia" (hear) is kept at Literal and Balanced, as in the call that opens 6:4; Readable says "Sikiliza" (listen), as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "nói vào tai các ngươi" (L)
decisions.reason: To speak in someone's ears is to speak to them directly (meaning decision); Vietnamese "nói vào tai" can keep the picture at Literal, while Balanced and Readable say "công bố cho", "nói cho ... biết".

decisions.choice: Moses' second speech keeps the address forms of the first: 해라체 with "너희" / "너" at Literal and Balanced, 합쇼체 with "여러분" at Readable
decisions.reason: The book-wide choice recorded at 1:1 holds for the speech that begins here.

decisions.choice: Ouve, Israel (L, B); Escuta, Israel (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 6:4; 9:1; 20:3): the call keeps the Hebrew singular, "Ouve", with no "ó", at Literal and Balanced; Readable says "Escuta", the everyday word, as the English Readable says "Listen" (r-en-1). Balanced gives the call a sentence of its own, since the rest of the verse is plural ("vocês"), so that no sentence mixes "tu" and "vocês" (4:1). Literal "guardarão" keeps the verb "guardar" that verses 10, 12 and 29 use (m4).

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic
alternatives: Mark pronouns for God with a setting span, as the English does
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the English setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; pronouns for God are written as for anyone else.

decisions.choice: Singular and plural address follow the Hebrew: "እስራኤል ሆይ፣ ስማ" (singular), then "ተማሯቸው" (plural)
alternatives: Use the plural throughout, as English cannot show the difference
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy turns between "you" in the singular, Israel as one person, and "you" in the plural, the people as many. Amharic can show the same turns with አንተ and እናንተ, so it follows the Hebrew verse by verse; the Ten Words (verses 6-21) are in the singular, as in Exodus 20.

decisions.choice: Horeb: the mountain called Sinai in Exodus
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy calls the mountain of the covenant Horeb (1:6; 4:10, 15). Exodus uses both names for it (Exodus 3:1; 19:11, 20). The covenant was made there about forty years before this speech (1:3).

decisions.choice: cut a covenant: make a binding agreement
decisions.reason: The verb is "cut". The phrase may come from the custom of cutting animals in two when a covenant was sworn (Genesis 15:9-18; Jeremiah 34:18). It had become the ordinary way to say "make a covenant".

decisions.choice: Mount Horeb
decisions.reason: Readable adds "Mount" so that new readers know Horeb is the mountain of verse 4.

decisions.choice: "언약을 맺다" for "cut a covenant"
decisions.reason: The term sheet keeps "언약" for covenant; "맺다" is the natural Korean verb, and the meaning decision explains the Hebrew idiom.

decisions.choice: "वाचा बाँधना" for "cut a covenant"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says a covenant is "cut" (m1). Hindi says "वाचा बाँधना" (bind a covenant) at every level, as the New Testament and the rest of the Pentateuch do; "काटना" would not be understood.

decisions.choice: "заключил завет" at every level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "cut a covenant" means to make a binding agreement (m2). Russian has its own fixed phrase, "заключить завет", which Literal uses too; a word-for-word "рассечь" would not be understood. ¦

source.text: לֹ֣א אֶת־אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ כָּרַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־הַבְּרִ֣ית הַזֹּ֑את כִּ֣י אִתָּ֗נוּ אֲנַ֨חְנוּ אֵ֥לֶּה פֹ֛ה הַיּ֖וֹם כֻּלָּ֥נוּ חַיִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Not with our fathers cut Yahweh the covenant the this, but with us, we, these here the day, all of us living.

en.L: Not with our fathers did {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} make this covenant, but with us, we, these [who are] here today, all of us living.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} did not make this covenant with our fathers; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made it with us, the ones here today, all of us still alive.
en.R: This covenant was not made with our ancestors. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} made it with us, every one of us here today who is still living.

es.L: No con nuestros padres hizo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} este pacto, sino con nosotros, nosotros, estos [que estamos] aquí hoy, todos nosotros vivos.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no hizo este pacto con nuestros padres; lo hizo con nosotros, los que estamos hoy aquí, todos los que aún vivimos.
es.R: Este pacto no se hizo con nuestros antepasados. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo hizo con nosotros, con cada uno de los que estamos hoy aquí y seguimos con vida.

fr.L: Ce n’est pas avec nos pères que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a conclu cette alliance, mais avec nous, nous, ceux [qui sommes] ici aujourd’hui, nous tous vivants.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’a pas conclu cette alliance avec nos pères ; c’est avec nous qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a conclue, nous qui sommes ici aujourd’hui, nous tous qui sommes encore en vie.
fr.R: Cette alliance n’a pas été faite avec nos ancêtres. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’a faite avec nous, avec chacun de nous qui sommes ici aujourd’hui et encore vivants.

sw.L: Si pamoja na baba zetu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alifanya agano hili, bali pamoja nasi, sisi, hawa [tulio] hapa leo, sisi sote tulio hai.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakufanya agano hili na baba zetu; alilifanya nasi, sisi tulio hapa leo, sisi sote ambao bado tu hai.
sw.R: Agano hili halikufanywa na mababu zetu. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alilifanya nasi, kila mmoja wetu aliye hapa leo na bado yu hai.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 언약을 우리 조상들과 맺으신 것이 아니라, 우리, 곧 오늘 여기 살아 있는 우리 모두와 맺으셨다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 언약을 우리 조상들과 맺으신 것이 아니다. 바로 우리, 오늘 여기 살아 있는 우리 모두와 맺으셨다.
ko.R: 이 언약은 우리 조상들과 맺어진 것이 아닙니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 이 언약을 우리와, 곧 오늘 여기 살아 있는 우리 한 사람 한 사람과 맺으셨습니다.

vi.L: Không phải với cha ông chúng ta mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã lập giao ước này, nhưng với chúng ta, chính chúng ta, những người ở đây hôm nay, tất cả chúng ta đang sống.

vi.R: Giao ước này không phải được lập với tổ tiên chúng ta. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã lập giao ước ấy với chúng ta, với mọi người chúng ta đang sống và có mặt ở đây hôm nay.

pt.L: Não com os nossos pais {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fez esta aliança, mas conosco, nós, estes [que estamos] aqui hoje, todos nós vivos.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} não fez esta aliança com os nossos antepassados; {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} a fez conosco, os que estamos aqui hoje, todos nós que ainda vivemos.
pt.R: Esta aliança não foi feita com os nossos antepassados. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} a fez conosco, com cada um de nós que está aqui hoje e ainda vive.

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने यह वाचा हमारे पितरों के साथ नहीं, परंतु हमारे साथ बाँधी, हम जो आज यहाँ [हैं], हम सब जो जीवित हैं।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने यह वाचा हमारे पितरों के साथ नहीं बाँधी; उन्होंने इसे हमारे साथ बाँधा, जो आज यहाँ हैं, हम सब के साथ जो अब तक जीवित हैं।
hi.R: यह वाचा हमारे पूर्वजों के साथ नहीं बाँधी गई थी। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने इसे हमारे साथ बाँधा, हम सब के साथ जो आज यहाँ जीवित हैं।

ru.L: Не с нашими отцами заключил {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} этот завет, но с нами, с нами, [теми, кто] здесь сегодня, все мы живые.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} заключил этот завет не с нашими отцами; {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} заключил его с нами, с теми, кто здесь сегодня, со всеми нами, кто ещё жив.
ru.R: Этот завет был заключён не с нашими {{gender:предками|отцами}}. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} заключил его с нами, с каждым из нас, кто сегодня здесь и ещё жив.

uk.L: Не з нашими батьками уклав {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} цей завіт, а з нами, ми, ці [що] тут сьогодні, всі ми живі.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} уклав цей завіт не з нашими батьками; {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} уклав його з нами, з тими, хто тут сьогодні, з усіма нами, хто ще живий.
uk.R: Цей завіт був укладений не з нашими предками. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} уклав його з нами, з кожним із нас, хто сьогодні тут і досі живий.

decisions.choice: not with our fathers, but with us: the covenant binds this generation directly
alternatives: not only with our fathers, but also with us
not with the patriarchs, but with us
decisions.reason: Most of the adults who stood at Horeb had died in the wilderness (2:14-16), and many who now listen were children then. Moses insists that the covenant was made with them, not as something handed down from the past. The "fathers" may be that dead generation, and then the saying means "not only with them, but with us", a way of speaking that puts all the weight on the second part. Or the fathers may be the patriarchs (4:31, 37; 7:8, 12), with whom God swore a covenant but to whom he did not give this one, and then the saying is meant just as it stands.

decisions.choice: with us, we, these here today, all of us living: heaped-up emphasis
decisions.reason: The Hebrew piles up words for the people present: "us", "we", "these", "here", "today", "all of us", "living". Each one presses the point that the covenant is theirs.

decisions.choice: with us, we, these [who are] here
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the repeated pronoun so the reader can see the emphasis (m2); Balanced and Readable carry it with "the ones here today, all of us" and "every one of us".

sw.L: Uso kwa uso {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alisema nanyi mlimani kutoka katikati ya moto,

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 산 위 불 가운데서 너희와 얼굴과 얼굴을 마주하여 말씀하셨다.

ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 산 위 불 속에서 여러분에게 직접 말씀하셨습니다.

vi.B: Trên núi, từ giữa lửa, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán với anh em mặt đối mặt.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã trực tiếp phán với anh em trên núi, từ giữa lửa.

pt.L: Face a face {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} falou com vocês no monte, do meio do fogo,
pt.B: No monte, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} falou com vocês face a face, do meio do fogo.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} falou diretamente com vocês no monte, do meio do fogo.

am.L: ፊት ለፊት {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በተራራው ላይ ከእሳቱ መካከል ከእናንተ ጋር ተናገረ፤

am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በተራራው ላይ ከእሳቱ መካከል ሆኖ በቀጥታ አነጋገራችሁ።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने पहाड़ पर आग के बीच में से तुमसे आमने-सामने बातें कीं,
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने पहाड़ पर आग में से तुमसे आमने-सामने बात की।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने पहाड़ पर आग के बीच में से सीधे तुमसे बात की।

ru.L: Лицом к лицу говорил {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} с вами на горе из среды огня,
ru.B: На горе {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} говорил с вами лицом к лицу из огня.

uk.B: На горі {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} говорив з вами віч-на-віч, із вогню.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} говорив до вас прямо на горі, з-посеред вогню.

decisions.choice: face to face: directly, in person, not through a messenger
decisions.reason: The phrase means that God himself spoke and the people heard his voice (verses 22-24; 4:12, 33, 36). It does not mean they saw him: they saw no form, only fire (4:12, 15). Exodus 33:11 and Numbers 12:8 use similar words of Moses alone; here the whole people heard the ten words for themselves.

decisions.choice: from the midst of the fire: the fire on the mountain at Horeb
decisions.reason: The mountain burned with fire when God came down on it (4:11; Exodus 19:18). Deuteronomy repeats that God spoke "from the midst of the fire" (4:12, 15, 33, 36; verses 22-26).

decisions.choice: directly
decisions.reason: Readable explains the idiom (m1) rather than keep "face to face", which could suggest that the people saw God.

source.text: אָ֠נֹכִי עֹמֵ֨ד בֵּין־יְהוָ֤ה וּבֵֽינֵיכֶם֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔וא לְהַגִּ֥יד לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־דְּבַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֤י יְרֵאתֶם֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י הָאֵ֔שׁ וְלֹֽא־עֲלִיתֶ֥ם בָּהָ֖ר לֵאמֹֽר׃ס

records.literal_gloss: I [was] standing between Yahweh and between you at the time the that to declare to you [the] word of Yahweh, for you were afraid from [the] face of the fire and not you went up on the mountain, saying,

en.L: I [was] standing between {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and you at that time to declare to you the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for you were afraid because of the fire and did not go up on the mountain, saying,
en.B: I was standing between {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and you at that time, to make known to you the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, since you were afraid of the fire and would not go up the mountain. He said:
en.R: Back then I stood between {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and you. I was there to tell you what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said, because you were afraid of the fire and would not climb the mountain. This is what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said:

es.L: yo [estaba] de pie entre {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} y {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en aquel tiempo, para {{plural_you:declararles|declararos}} la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, porque {{plural_you:tuvieron|tuvisteis}} miedo del fuego y no {{plural_you:subieron|subisteis}} al monte, diciendo:
es.B: En aquel tiempo yo estaba entre {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} y {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} para {{plural_you:darles|daros}} a conocer la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, ya que {{plural_you:tenían|teníais}} miedo del fuego y no {{plural_you:quisieron|quisisteis}} subir al monte. Él dijo:
es.R: En aquel tiempo yo me puse entre {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} y {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Estaba allí para {{plural_you:decirles|deciros}} lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} decía, porque {{plural_you:tenían|teníais}} miedo del fuego y no {{plural_you:quisieron|quisisteis}} subir al monte. Esto es lo que dijo:

fr.L: je me tenais entre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et vous en ce temps-là, pour vous annoncer la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, car vous avez eu peur à cause du feu et vous n’êtes pas montés sur la montagne, en disant :
fr.B: Je me tenais alors entre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et vous, pour vous faire connaître la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, parce que vous aviez peur du feu et que vous ne vouliez pas monter sur la montagne. Il a dit :
fr.R: À ce moment-là, je me tenais entre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et vous. J’étais là pour vous dire ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} disait, car vous aviez peur du feu et vous ne vouliez pas gravir la montagne. Voici ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a dit :

sw.L: mimi nilikuwa nimesimama kati ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na ninyi wakati ule, ili kuwatangazia neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana mliogopa kwa sababu ya moto, wala hamkupanda mlimani, akisema,
sw.B: Wakati huo nilikuwa nimesimama kati ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na ninyi, ili niwajulishe neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa kuwa mliuogopa moto na hamkutaka kupanda mlimani. Alisema:
sw.R: Wakati huo nilisimama kati ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na ninyi. Nilikuwepo ili niwaambie yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyosema, kwa sababu mliuogopa moto na hamkutaka kupanda mlima. Hiki ndicho alichosema:

ko.L: 그때에 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}와 너희 사이에 서서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 너희에게 전했다. 너희가 불 때문에 두려워하여 산에 올라가지 않았기 때문이다. 그분께서 말씀하셨다.
ko.B: 그때에 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}와 너희 사이에 서서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 너희에게 알려 주었다. 너희가 불을 두려워하여 산에 올라가지 않았기 때문이다. 그분께서 말씀하셨다.
ko.R: 그때에 저는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}와 여러분 사이에 서 있었습니다. 저는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하신 말씀을 여러분에게 전해 주려고 거기에 있었습니다. 여러분이 불을 무서워하여 산에 올라가지 않았기 때문입니다. 그분께서 이렇게 말씀하셨습니다.

vi.L: (tôi đứng giữa {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và các ngươi vào lúc ấy để công bố cho các ngươi lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì các ngươi sợ lửa và không đi lên núi) rằng:
vi.B: Lúc ấy tôi đứng giữa {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và anh em để truyền lại cho anh em lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì anh em sợ lửa và không dám lên núi. Ngài phán:
vi.R: Hồi đó tôi đã đứng giữa {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và anh em. Tôi ở đó để nói cho anh em biết những gì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, vì anh em sợ lửa và không dám lên núi. Đây là những lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán:

pt.L: Eu [estava] de pé entre {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e vocês naquele tempo, para anunciar a vocês a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, porque vocês tiveram medo do fogo e não subiram ao monte, dizendo:
pt.B: Naquele tempo eu estava entre {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e vocês, para lhes dar a conhecer a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, pois vocês tiveram medo do fogo e não quiseram subir o monte. Ele disse:
pt.R: Naquele tempo eu fiquei entre {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e vocês. Eu estava ali para contar a vocês o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dizia, porque vocês tinham medo do fogo e não quiseram subir o monte. Foi isto o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} disse:

am.L: እኔም በዚያን ጊዜ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ቃል እነግራችሁ ዘንድ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔርና|በያህዌና}} በእናንተ መካከል ቆሜ ነበር፤ ከእሳቱ የተነሣ ፈርታችሁ ነበርና፤ ወደ ተራራውም አልወጣችሁም፤ እንዲህ ሲል፦
am.B: በዚያን ጊዜ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ቃል እንዳስታውቃችሁ እኔ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔርና|በያህዌና}} በእናንተ መካከል ቆሜ ነበር፤ እሳቱን ፈርታችሁ ወደ ተራራው አልወጣችሁምና። እርሱም እንዲህ አለ፦
am.R: በዚያን ጊዜ እኔ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔርና|በያህዌና}} በእናንተ መካከል ቆምኩ። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የተናገረውን ልነግራችሁ በዚያ ነበርኩ፤ እናንተ እሳቱን ፈርታችሁ ወደ ተራራው አልወጣችሁምና። እርሱ ያለው ይህ ነው፦

hi.L: उस समय मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के और तुम्हारे बीच खड़ा [था] कि तुम्हें {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का वचन बताऊँ, क्योंकि तुम आग के कारण डर गए थे और पहाड़ पर नहीं चढ़े। उन्होंने कहा,
hi.B: उस समय मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के और तुम्हारे बीच खड़ा था कि तुम्हें {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का वचन सुनाऊँ, क्योंकि तुम आग से डरते थे और पहाड़ पर नहीं चढ़े। उन्होंने कहा:
hi.R: उस समय मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के और तुम्हारे बीच खड़ा रहा। मैं वहाँ इसलिए था कि तुम्हें बताऊँ कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने क्या कहा, क्योंकि तुम आग से डरते थे और पहाड़ पर नहीं चढ़ना चाहते थे। उन्होंने यह कहा:

ru.L: Я стоял между {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}} и вами в то время, чтобы возвестить вам слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, потому что вы боялись огня и не поднялись на гору, говоря:
ru.B: В то время я стоял между {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}} и вами, чтобы возвестить вам слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, потому что вы боялись огня и не захотели подняться на гору. Он сказал:
ru.R: Тогда я стоял между {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}} и вами. Я был там, чтобы передать вам, что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, потому что вы боялись огня и не захотели подняться на гору. Вот что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сказал:

uk.L: я стояв між {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}} і вами того часу, щоб оголосити вам слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, бо ви боялися вогню і не піднялися на гору, кажучи:
uk.B: Того часу я стояв між {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}} і вами, щоб передати вам слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, бо ви боялися вогню й не захотіли піднятися на гору. Він сказав:
uk.R: Тоді я стояв між {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}} і вами. Я був там, щоб переказати вам, що говорив {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, бо ви боялися вогню і не хотіли йти на гору. Ось що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} сказав:

decisions.choice: saying: introduces the words God spoke, picking up verse 4
decisions.reason: Verse 5 is an aside about Moses' part in the events. The word "saying" at its end does not introduce words of Moses; it goes back to "Yahweh spoke with you" in verse 4 and opens God's own words in verses 6-21.

decisions.choice: standing between: Moses as the go-between for God and the people
decisions.reason: The people heard God's voice (verse 4), yet Moses stood between them because they feared the fire (verses 23-27; Exodus 20:18-21). The two statements fit together: they heard the ten words themselves, and Moses carried everything else God said to them (verse 31).

decisions.choice: afraid from the face of the fire: afraid because of the fire
decisions.reason: "From the face of" is a common way of saying "because of" or "in the presence of".

decisions.choice: He said: / This is what he said:
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable end the aside and begin a new sentence, so they supply who speaks, God (m1). Literal keeps the single word "saying".

decisions.choice: the aside in brackets, then "rằng:" (L)
decisions.reason: "saying" at the end of the verse picks up "spoke" in verse 4 (meaning decision); Literal sets Moses' explanation in parentheses so that "rằng" can lead into God's words. Balanced and Readable make it a sentence of its own, as the English does.

source.text: אָֽנֹכִי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֧ר הוֹצֵאתִ֛יךָ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם מִבֵּ֥יתעֲבָדִֽים

records.literal_gloss: I [am] Yahweh your God, who brought you out from [the] land of Egypt, from a house of slaves.

en.L: 'I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, who brought you out from the land of Egypt, from the house of slaves.
en.B: 'I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. I brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house where you were slaves.
en.R: 'I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. I brought you out of Egypt, where you lived as slaves.

es.L: “Yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios, que te hice salir de la tierra de Egipto, de la casa de esclavos.
es.B: “Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios. Fui yo quien te sacó del país de Egipto, de la casa en que servías como esclavo.
es.R: “Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios. Yo te rescaté de Egipto, donde vivías como esclavo.

fr.L: “Je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu, qui t’ai fait sortir du pays d’Égypte, de la maison des esclaves.
fr.B: “Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu. C’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qui t’ai fait sortir du pays d’Égypte, de la maison où tu servais comme esclave.
fr.R: “Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu. Je t’ai fait sortir d’Égypte, où tu vivais comme esclave.

sw.L: 'Mimi [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, ambaye nilikutoa kutoka nchi ya Misri, kutoka nyumba ya watumwa.
sw.B: 'Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako. Nilikuleta nje ya nchi ya Misri, kutoka nyumba ulimotumikishwa kama mtumwa.
sw.R: 'Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako. Nilikutoa Misri, ulikoishi ukiwa mtumwa.

ko.L: '나는 너를 이집트 땅, 노예들의 집에서 이끌어 낸 너의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이다.
ko.B: '나는 너의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이다. 내가 너를 이집트 땅, 네가 노예로 살던 집에서 이끌어 냈다.
ko.R: '나는 너의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이다. 나는 네가 노예로 살던 이집트에서 너를 이끌어 냈다.

vi.L: 'Ta [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi, Đấng đã đem ngươi ra khỏi xứ Ai Cập, khỏi nhà nô lệ.
vi.B: 'Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi. Ta đã đem ngươi ra khỏi đất Ai Cập, ra khỏi nơi ngươi làm nô lệ.
vi.R: 'Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi. Ta đã đem ngươi ra khỏi Ai Cập, là nơi ngươi sống làm nô lệ.

pt.L: 'Eu [sou] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, teu Deus, que te tirei da terra do Egito, da casa de escravos.
pt.B: 'Eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, teu Deus. Eu te fiz sair da terra do Egito, da casa da escravidão.
pt.R: 'Eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, teu Deus. Eu te tirei do Egito, onde vivias como escravo.

am.L: “እኔ አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} [ነኝ]፤ ከግብፅ ምድር፣ ከባሮች ቤት ያወጣሁህ [እኔ ነኝ]።
am.B: “እኔ አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነኝ። ከግብፅ ምድር፣ ባሪያ ሆነህ ከኖርክበት ቤት አወጣሁህ።
am.R: “እኔ አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነኝ። ባሪያ ሆነህ ትኖርበት ከነበረው ከግብፅ አወጣሁህ።

hi.L: 'मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारा परमेश्वर [हूँ], जो तुम्हें मिस्र देश से, दासों के घर से, निकाल लाया।
hi.B: 'मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारा परमेश्वर हूँ। मैं तुम्हें मिस्र देश से, उस घर से जहाँ तुम दास थे, निकाल लाया।
hi.R: 'मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारा परमेश्वर हूँ। मैं तुम्हें मिस्र से निकाल लाया, जहाँ तुम दास बनकर रहते थे।

ru.L: “Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, который вывел тебя из земли Египта, из дома рабов.
ru.B: “Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог. Я вывел тебя из земли Египта, из дома, где ты был рабом.
ru.R: “Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог. Я вывел тебя из Египта, где ты жил в рабстве.

uk.L: “Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, який вивів тебе з краю Єгипту, з дому рабів.
uk.B: “Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог. Я вивів тебе з єгипетської землі, з дому, де ти був рабом.
uk.R: “Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог. Я вивів тебе з Єгипту, де ти жив як раб.

decisions.choice: the ten words, as given in Exodus 20:2-17
decisions.reason: Moses repeats the ten words God spoke at Horeb (Exodus 20:2-17). Most of the wording is the same, but there are differences: the Sabbath is to be "kept" rather than "remembered" and is given a different reason (verses 12-15), two promises are added (verse 16), the last commands are joined by "and" (verses 18-21), and the coveting command names the wife first and adds the field (verse 21). Here the words are quoted within Moses' speech.

decisions.choice: I am Yahweh your God: God names himself before he commands
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 20:2, the words can also be read "I, Yahweh, am your God". Either way God first says who he is and what he has done, and the commands rest on that rescue.

decisions.choice: house of slaves: Egypt as the place of slavery
decisions.reason: The phrase pictures Egypt as a household where Israel served as slaves (6:12; 7:8; 8:14; Exodus 13:3; 20:2). Verse 15 returns to it.

decisions.choice: the ten words are counted in more than one way
decisions.reason: Scripture says there are ten (4:13; 10:4) but does not number them. Communities count them differently, as noted at Exodus 20:2; Deuteronomy's form of the last command (verse 21) is the basis of one of those counts.

decisions.choice: slaves
decisions.reason: "Slaves" at every level, since this is Israel's slavery in Egypt, as at Exodus 20:2.

decisions.choice: the wording of Exodus 20:2-17 in Spanish, changed only where the Hebrew of Deuteronomy differs; “ ” inside Moses' speech
decisions.reason: Where the Hebrew is the same as in Exodus, the Spanish is the same, so that the real differences (the Sabbath "guardado", its reason, the coveting command) stand out.

decisions.choice: the wording of Exodus 20:2-17 in French, changed only where the Hebrew of Deuteronomy differs; “ ” for God's words inside Moses' speech
decisions.reason: The ten words are quoted inside Moses' speech, so they open with the inner quotation mark. Where the Hebrew is the same as in Exodus, the French is the same, so that a reader comparing the two sees only the real differences (the Sabbath "gardé", its reason, the coveting command).

decisions.choice: the wording of Exodus 20:2-17 in Swahili, changed only where the Hebrew of Deuteronomy differs
decisions.reason: Where the Hebrew is the same as in Exodus, the Swahili is the same, so that the real differences ("Shika" the Sabbath, its reason, the coveting command) stand out.

decisions.choice: God's ten words in 해라체 with "너" at every level, Balanced and Readable included, following the Hebrew singular
decisions.reason: God speaks in 해라체 throughout, and Readable keeps God's quoted words in that style even inside Moses' 합쇼체 address. Balanced keeps the singular "너" through the ten words, as the book-wide choice recorded at 1:21 allows for a long singular passage; the wording stays close to the Korean Exodus 20 so that the two versions can be compared, while following this text's own differences.

decisions.choice: "ngươi", singular, at every level in the ten words
decisions.reason: God speaks to Israel as one person through verse 21; Vietnamese keeps the singular "ngươi", as in Exodus 20. These are God's own words, so Moses' "anh em" does not apply inside them.

decisions.choice: the Portuguese of Exodus 20:2-17, changed only where the Hebrew differs
decisions.reason: Moses repeats the ten words of Exodus 20 (m1), so verses 6-21 keep the Portuguese of Exodus 20:2-17 at every level wherever the Hebrew is the same: God's "tu" to Israel at every level, "teu Deus" without the article, the future "Não farás" at Literal and Balanced and the imperative "Não faças" at Readable, "um Deus zeloso", "amor leal". Only what Deuteronomy says differently is changed (verses 8, 9, 12, 14-16, 18-21). God's words open with a single quotation mark, as in the English, because they stand inside Moses' speech.

decisions.choice: The Ten Words in the Amharic of Exodus 20:2-17, word for word where the Hebrew is the same
alternatives: The familiar wording of the 1962 Amharic Bible
decisions.reason: Exodus 20 and Deuteronomy 5 give the same ten words, so the Amharic is the same wherever the Hebrew is, and differs only where Deuteronomy's Hebrew does: "keep" for "remember" and the added "as the LORD commanded you" (verses 12, 16), the ox and donkey and the servants' rest (verse 14), the reason for the Sabbath (verse 15), "that it may go well with you" (verse 16), the chain of "and" (verses 18-21), "a witness of emptiness" (verse 20), and the order and verbs of the last command (verse 21). Each difference has its own note. Inside Moses' speech the words take the inner marks “ ”.

decisions.choice: the Ten Commandments in the wording of Exodus 20, changed only where the Hebrew differs
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 5:6-21 repeats the Ten Commandments of Exodus 20:2-17. Where the Hebrew is the same, Hindi keeps the wording of Exodus 20 at each level (Literal "तुम ... नहीं करोगे", Balanced and Readable "... मत करो"), and verses 17-20 also match Jesus' quotation in Matthew 19:18-19. Where Deuteronomy differs (verses 12, 14-16, 20, 21), the Hindi differs in the same places.

decisions.choice: the wording of Exodus 20:2-17 in this translation, where the Hebrew is the same
alternatives: a fresh rendering of the ten words
decisions.reason: The ten words are given again here, with some differences (m1). Every level keeps the Russian of Exodus 20 where the Hebrew is the same, and differs only where the Hebrew does (verses 12, 14-15, 20, 21), so that readers can see what Deuteronomy changes. ¦

decisions.choice: "дом рабов" (L); "дом, где ты был рабом" (B); "рабство" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 20:2, and for the whole of Deuteronomy: the slavery in Egypt is "рабство" and the slave "раб" at every level (m3). ¦

decisions.choice: "з дому рабів" (L); "з дому, де ти був рабом" (B)
decisions.reason: The ten words are drafted from the Hebrew and the gloss, not from a printed Ukrainian Bible. Literal keeps the Hebrew "house of slaves"; Balanced says plainly that Israel was the slave there.

decisions.choice: God's "you" in the ten words is "ти" at every level, as the Hebrew singular
decisions.reason: The commands are spoken to Israel as one and to each hearer; Ukrainian keeps the singular, as the Hebrew has it, while Moses' frame around them (verses 1-5, 22-33) is plural.

source.text: לֹא־יִהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֛אֱלֹהִ֥יםאֲחֵרִ֖יםעַל־פָּנָֽיַ

records.literal_gloss: Not will be to you other gods on my face.

en.L: There shall not be for you other gods before {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} face.
en.B: You shall have no other gods besides {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.R: Do not have any other gods except {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

es.L: No habrá para ti otros dioses delante de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} rostro.
es.B: No tendrás ningún otro dios aparte de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}.
es.R: Fuera de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, no tengas ningún otro dios.

fr.L: Il n’y aura pas pour toi d’autres dieux devant {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} face.
fr.B: Tu n’auras aucun autre dieu à côté de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.
fr.R: N’aie aucun autre dieu que {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.

sw.L: Hakutakuwa kwako miungu mingine mbele ya uso {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.
sw.B: Hutakuwa na mungu mwingine yeyote kando {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.
sw.R: Mungu wako ni {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} tu; usiwe na mwingine.

ko.L: 너에게는 내 얼굴 앞에 다른 신들이 있어서는 안 된다.
ko.B: 너는 나 말고 다른 신들을 두지 말라.
ko.R: 나 말고 다른 신을 두면 안 된다.

vi.L: Ngươi chớ có các thần khác trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: Ngươi không được có thần nào khác ngoài {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Đừng thờ thần nào khác ngoài {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

pt.L: Não haverá para ti outros deuses diante da {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} face.
pt.B: Não terás nenhum outro deus além de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}.
pt.R: Não tenhas nenhum outro deus além de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}.

am.L: በፊቴ ሌሎች አማልክት አይሁኑልህ።
am.B: ከእኔ ጎን ሌሎች አማልክት አይኑሩህ።
am.R: ከእኔ ሌላ ምንም አምላክ አይኑርህ።

hi.L: मेरे मुख के सामने तुम्हारे लिए दूसरे देवता नहीं होंगे।
hi.B: मेरे सिवा तुम्हारे कोई दूसरे देवता न हों।
hi.R: मेरे सिवा किसी और देवता को मत मानो।

ru.L: Не будет у тебя иных богов перед {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} лицом.
ru.B: Пусть у тебя не будет никаких других богов, кроме {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}.
ru.R: Не имей никаких других богов, кроме {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}.

uk.L: Не буде в тебе інших богів перед {{deity_pronoun:моїм|Моїм}} обличчям.
uk.B: Ти не матимеш інших богів, крім {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}.
uk.R: У тебе не може бути жодних інших богів, крім {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}.

decisions.choice: on my face: besides me, in my presence
decisions.reason: The same words as Exodus 20:3. The phrase may mean "besides me", "in my presence" or "in defiance of me"; each reading forbids Israel any god but Yahweh.

decisions.choice: other gods: no rival may share Israel's loyalty
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy returns to this command again and again (6:14; 7:4; 8:19; 13:3).

decisions.choice: You shall not ... (Literal, Balanced); Do not ... (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 20, the commands use the form of a lasting prohibition. Literal and Balanced say "You shall not"; Readable uses the plain "Do not".

decisions.choice: future at L and B ("no tendrás", "no harás"); negative imperative at R ("no tengas", "no hagas")
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 20: the future of law at Literal and Balanced, the plain command at Readable.

decisions.choice: future with "ne ... pas" at L and B ("tu n'auras pas", "tu ne feras pas"); imperative at R ("n'aie pas", "ne fais pas")
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 20. The commands are lasting prohibitions; Literal and Balanced use the French future of law, Readable the plain imperative, as the English Readable says "Do not".

decisions.choice: -ta- future with the negative ("hutakuwa", "hutafanya") or the negative subjunctive at L and B; the negative subjunctive at R ("usiwe", "usiibe")
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 20: the lasting prohibition at Literal and Balanced, the plain command at Readable.

source.text: לֹֽ֣א־תַעֲשֶׂ֥ה לְךָ֥פֶ֨סֶל֙כָּל־תְּמוּנָ֔האֲשֶׁ֤רבַּשָּׁמַ֨יִם֙מִמַּ֔עַלוַאֲשֶׁ֥רבָּאָ֖רֶץמִתָּ֑חַתוַאֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּמַּ֖יִםמִתַּ֥חַתלָאָֽרֶץ

records.literal_gloss: Not you shall make for yourself a carved image, any form which [is] in the heavens above and which [is] on the earth beneath and which [is] in the waters under the earth.

en.L: You shall not make for yourself a carved image, any form that [is] in the heavens above, or that [is] on the earth beneath, or that [is] in the waters under the earth.
en.B: You shall not make yourself a carved idol in the form of anything in the heavens overhead, on the earth below, or in the waters beneath the earth.
en.R: Do not make any idol for yourself in the shape of anything in the sky, on the land, or in the water below the land.

es.L: No te harás imagen tallada, forma alguna de lo que [está] en los cielos arriba, o de lo que [está] en la tierra abajo, o de lo que [está] en las aguas bajo la tierra.
es.B: No te fabricarás ningún ídolo tallado con la forma de cosa alguna que haya allá arriba en los cielos, aquí abajo en la tierra o en las aguas por debajo de la tierra.
es.R: No te fabriques ningún ídolo con la forma de nada que haya en el cielo, en la tierra o en el agua debajo de la tierra.

fr.L: Tu ne te feras pas d’image sculptée, aucune forme de ce qui [est] dans les cieux en haut, ou de ce qui [est] sur la terre en bas, ou de ce qui [est] dans les eaux sous la terre.
fr.B: Tu ne te fabriqueras pas d’idole taillée qui ait la forme de quoi que ce soit, là-haut dans le ciel, ici-bas sur la terre ou dans les eaux au-dessous de la terre.
fr.R: Ne te fabrique aucune idole qui ait la forme de quoi que ce soit dans le ciel, sur la terre, ou dans l’eau sous la terre.

sw.L: Hutajifanyia sanamu ya kuchonga, umbo lolote la kitu kilicho katika mbingu juu, au kilicho katika nchi chini, au kilicho katika maji chini ya nchi.
sw.B: Hutajitengenezea sanamu iliyochongwa yenye umbo la kitu chochote kilichoko mbinguni juu, katika ardhi chini, au ndani ya maji yaliyo chini ya ardhi.
sw.R: Usijitengenezee sanamu ya kuabudu yenye umbo la kitu chochote kilicho angani, juu ya nchi kavu, au ndani ya maji chini ya nchi.

ko.L: 너는 너를 위하여 새긴 우상을 만들지 말라. 위로 하늘에 있는 것이나 아래로 땅에 있는 것이나 땅 아래 물속에 있는 것의 어떤 형상도 [만들지 말라].
ko.B: 너는 너 자신을 위하여 새긴 우상을 만들지 말라. 위로 하늘에 있는 것이든, 아래로 땅에 있는 것이든, 땅 아래 물속에 있는 것이든, 그 어떤 것의 형상도 만들지 말라.
ko.R: 너를 위해 우상을 만들면 안 된다. 하늘에 있는 것이든, 땅에 있는 것이든, 땅 아래 물속에 있는 것이든, 그 어떤 것의 모양으로도 우상을 만들면 안 된다.

vi.L: Ngươi chớ làm cho mình tượng chạm, bất cứ hình dạng nào [của vật] ở trên trời cao, hay ở dưới đất thấp, hay ở trong nước dưới đất.
vi.B: Ngươi không được làm cho mình tượng thần chạm trổ theo hình dạng của bất cứ vật gì ở trên trời cao, ở dưới đất thấp, hay ở trong nước bên dưới mặt đất.
vi.R: Đừng làm cho mình một thần tượng nào theo hình dạng của bất cứ vật gì ở trên trời, trên mặt đất, hay ở dưới nước.

pt.L: Não farás para ti uma imagem esculpida, qualquer forma do que [está] nos céus, em cima, ou do que [está] na terra, embaixo, ou do que [está] nas águas, debaixo da terra.
pt.B: Não farás para ti um ídolo esculpido na forma de coisa alguma que esteja no céu, lá em cima, na terra, aqui embaixo, ou nas águas que ficam abaixo da terra.
pt.R: Não faças para ti nenhum ídolo com a forma de qualquer coisa que existe no céu, na terra ou nas águas debaixo da terra.

am.L: ለራስህ የተቀረጸ ምስል አትሥራ፤ በላይ በሰማያት ያለውን፣ በታችም በምድር ያለውን፣ ከምድርም በታች በውኃ ያለውን የማንኛውንም ነገር መልክ [አትሥራ]።
am.B: ለራስህ የተቀረጸ ጣዖት አትሥራ፤ ደግሞም በላይ በሰማይ፣ በታች በምድር፣ ወይም ከምድር በታች በውኃ ውስጥ ያለውን የማንኛውንም ነገር ቅርጽ አትሥራ።
am.R: ለራስህ ምንም ዓይነት ጣዖት አትሥራ። በሰማይ፣ በምድር ወይም ከምድር በታች ባለው ውኃ ውስጥ ያለውን የማንኛውንም ነገር ሐውልት ወይም ሥዕል አትሥራ።

hi.L: तुम अपने लिए कोई खुदी हुई मूर्ति नहीं बनाओगे, न किसी वस्तु का कोई रूप जो ऊपर आकाश में, या नीचे पृथ्वी पर, या पृथ्वी के नीचे के जल में [है]।
hi.B: अपने लिए कोई गढ़ी हुई मूर्ति मत बनाओ, न ऊपर आकाश की, न नीचे पृथ्वी की, और न पृथ्वी के नीचे के जल की किसी वस्तु की आकृति।
hi.R: अपने लिए कोई मूर्ति मत बनाओ। आकाश में, धरती पर, या धरती के नीचे के पानी में की किसी भी चीज़ की मूर्ति या चित्र मत बनाओ।

ru.L: Не будешь делать себе резного изваяния, никакого образа того, что на небесах вверху, и что на земле внизу, и что в водах под землёй.
ru.B: Не делай себе резного идола в образе чего-либо, что в небесах над тобой, на земле под тобой или в водах под землёй.
ru.R: Не делай себе никаких идолов в виде того, что в небе, на земле или в воде под землёй.

uk.L: Не роби собі різьбленого ідола, жодного образу того, що [є] на небі вгорі, чи що [є] на землі внизу, чи що [є] у водах під землею.
uk.B: Не роби собі різьбленого ідола у вигляді будь-чого, що є на небі вгорі, на землі внизу чи у водах під землею.
uk.R: Не можна робити собі ідола, схожого на будь-що в небі, на суші чи у воді під сушею.

decisions.choice: a carved image, any form: an idol in the shape of anything
decisions.reason: Exodus 20:4 reads "a carved image and any form", two things forbidden. Here there is no "and", so "any form" describes the image: an idol shaped like anything in the world. The command forbids the same thing either way.

decisions.choice: no image of anything, including of Yahweh himself
decisions.reason: 4:15-18 gives the reason: Israel saw no form when Yahweh spoke from the fire, so they must make no image of anything, whether of another god or meant to stand for him.

decisions.choice: heavens, earth, waters under the earth: the whole created world
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 20:4, the three parts name everything there is: the birds and lights of the sky, land animals and people, and fish (4:16-19).

decisions.choice: uma imagem esculpida, qualquer forma (L); um ídolo esculpido na forma de (B); nenhum ídolo com a forma de (R)
decisions.reason: Here there is no "and" before "any form", so the form describes the image (m1). Portuguese drops the "nem" of Exodus 20:4 at Literal and joins the two at Balanced and Readable; the rest of the verse keeps the Exodus wording.

decisions.choice: future "не будешь делать" (L); imperative "не делай" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 20 and in Matthew 19:18 in this translation, Literal renders the Hebrew "you shall not" with the future, Balanced and Readable with the imperative, as the Pentateuch note settles for laws. ¦

source.text: לֹא־תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֥הלָהֶ֖םוְלֹ֣א תָעָבְדֵ֑םכִּ֣י אָנֹכִ֞י יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ אֵ֣ל קַנָּ֔א פֹּ֠קֵד עֲוֺ֨ן אָב֧וֹת עַל־בָּנִ֛ים וְעַל־שִׁלֵּשִׁ֥ים וְעַל־רִבֵּעִ֖ים לְשֹׂנְאָֽי

records.literal_gloss: Not you shall bow down to them and not you shall be made to serve them, for I, Yahweh your God, [am] a jealous God, visiting [the] iniquity of fathers on children, and on [the] third and on [the] fourth of those who hate me,

en.L: You shall not bow down to them, and you shall not serve them; for I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, [am] a jealous God, visiting [the] iniquity of fathers upon children, and upon [the] third and upon [the] fourth [generation] of those who hate {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}},
en.B: You shall neither bow to them nor serve them. For I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, am a jealous God. I bring the guilt of fathers upon their children, upon the third and the fourth generation of those who hate {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}},
en.R: Do not bow down to them or serve them. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, and I am a jealous God. I will not share your loyalty with other gods. When people hate {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, I punish their sin, even in their grandchildren and great-grandchildren.

es.L: No te postrarás ante ellas, y no las servirás; porque yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios, [soy] un Dios celoso, que visita la iniquidad de los padres sobre los hijos, y sobre la tercera y sobre la cuarta [generación] de los que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} odian,
es.B: No te inclinarás ante ellos ni les rendirás culto. Pues yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios, un Dios celoso. Hago caer la culpa de los padres sobre sus hijos, sobre la tercera y la cuarta generación de los que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} odian,
es.R: No te arrodilles ante ellos ni les sirvas. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios, y soy un Dios celoso: no permito que tu lealtad sea también para otros dioses. Cuando alguien {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} odia, castigo su pecado, aun en sus nietos y bisnietos.

fr.L: Tu ne te prosterneras pas devant elles, et tu ne les serviras pas ; car {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu, [je suis] un Dieu jaloux, qui visite la faute des pères sur les fils, et sur la troisième et sur la quatrième [génération] de ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} haïssent,
fr.B: Tu ne t’inclineras pas devant elles et tu ne leur rendras pas de culte. Je suis en effet {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu, un Dieu jaloux. Je fais retomber la faute des pères sur leurs enfants, sur la troisième et la quatrième génération de ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} haïssent,
fr.R: Ne te prosterne pas devant elles et ne les sers pas. Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu, et je suis un Dieu jaloux : je ne veux pas que ta fidélité soit partagée avec d’autres dieux. Quand des gens {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} haïssent, je punis leur péché, même chez leurs petits-enfants et leurs arrière-petits-enfants.

sw.L: Hutaviinamia, wala hutavitumikia; kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, [ni] Mungu mwenye wivu, ninayeadhibu uovu wa baba juu ya watoto, na juu ya [kizazi cha] tatu na juu ya [kizazi cha] nne cha wale wanaonichukia,
sw.B: Hutaviinamia wala kuvitumikia. Kwa maana ndimi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, Mungu mwenye wivu. Ninaleta hatia ya baba juu ya watoto wao, juu ya vizazi vya tatu na vya nne vya wale wanaonichukia,
sw.R: Usiziinamie sanamu hizo wala kuzitumikia. Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} ni Mungu mwenye wivu. Sitakubali uaminifu wako ugawanywe na miungu mingine. Watu wanaponichukia, ninaiadhibu dhambi yao, hata kwa wajukuu wao na vitukuu vyao.

ko.L: 너는 그것들에게 절하지 말고 그것들을 섬기지 말라. 나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너의 하나님은 질투하는 하나님이어서, 나를 미워하는 자들의 아버지들의 죄악을 자녀들에게, 삼 대와 사 대까지 갚는다.
ko.B: 너는 그것들에게 절하지도 말고 섬기지도 말라. 나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너의 하나님은 질투하는 하나님이다. 나를 미워하는 사람들에게는 아버지들의 죄악을 그 자녀들에게 갚되, 삼 대와 사 대까지 갚는다.
ko.R: 우상에게 절하거나 우상을 섬기면 안 된다. 나는 너의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이고, 질투하는 하나님이다. 나는 네 충성을 다른 신들과 나누지 않는다. 사람들이 나를 미워하면, 나는 그들의 죄를 벌하고, 그 벌이 그들의 손자와 증손자에게까지 미치게 한다.

vi.L: Ngươi chớ quỳ lạy chúng và chớ phụng sự chúng; vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi, [là] Đức Chúa Trời kỵ tà, phạt [tội] gian ác của cha trên con cái, đến [đời] thứ ba và [đời] thứ tư của những kẻ ghét {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}},
vi.B: Ngươi không được quỳ lạy hay phụng sự chúng, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi, là Đức Chúa Trời kỵ tà. Ta phạt tội của cha ông trên con cháu đến đời thứ ba và thứ tư của những kẻ ghét {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}},
vi.R: Đừng quỳ lạy hay phục vụ chúng. Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi, Đức Chúa Trời kỵ tà. Ta không để ngươi chia lòng trung thành với các thần khác. Khi người ta ghét {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} phạt tội của họ, ngay cả trên con cháu và chắt chít họ.

pt.L: Não te prostrarás diante deles e não os servirás; pois eu, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, teu Deus, [sou] um Deus zeloso, que visito a iniquidade dos pais sobre os filhos, e sobre a terceira e sobre a quarta [geração] dos que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} odeiam,
pt.B: Não te curvarás diante deles nem os servirás. Pois eu, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, teu Deus, sou um Deus zeloso. Faço cair a culpa dos pais sobre os filhos, sobre a terceira e a quarta geração daqueles que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} odeiam,
pt.R: Não te curves diante deles nem os sirvas. Eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, teu Deus, e sou um Deus zeloso. Não aceito dividir a tua lealdade com outros deuses. Quando as pessoas {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} odeiam, eu castigo o pecado delas, até nos seus netos e bisnetos.

am.L: አትስገድላቸው፤ አታገልግላቸውም፤ እኔ፣ አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ የሚቀና አምላክ [ነኝ]ና፤ የአባቶችን በደል በልጆች ላይ፣ ከሚጠሉኝም በሦስተኛውና በአራተኛው [ትውልድ] ላይ የማመጣ [ነኝ]፣
am.B: ለእነርሱ አትስገድ፤ አታገልግላቸውም። እኔ አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የምቀና አምላክ ነኝና። ከሚጠሉኝ መካከል የአባቶችን በደል በልጆቻቸው ላይ፣ እስከ ሦስተኛውና አራተኛው ትውልድ ድረስ አመጣለሁ፤
am.R: ለእነርሱ አትስገድ፤ አታገልግላቸውም። እኔ አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነኝ፤ የምቀናም አምላክ ነኝ። ታማኝነትህ ለእኔ ብቻ ይሁን፤ ከሌሎች አማልክት ጋር አልካፈለውም። ሰዎች ሲጠሉኝ ኃጢአታቸውን እቀጣለሁ፤ ቅጣቱም እስከ ልጅ ልጆቻቸውና እስከ ልጅ ልጅ ልጆቻቸው ድረስ ይደርሳል።

hi.L: तुम उन्हें दंडवत नहीं करोगे, और न उनकी सेवा करोगे; क्योंकि मैं, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारा परमेश्वर, जलन रखनेवाला परमेश्वर [हूँ], जो मुझसे बैर रखनेवालों के पितरों के अधर्म का दंड सन्तान पर, और तीसरी और चौथी [पीढ़ी] पर, लाता हूँ,
hi.B: न उन्हें दंडवत करो और न उनकी सेवा करो। क्योंकि मैं, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारा परमेश्वर, जलन रखनेवाला परमेश्वर हूँ। जो मुझसे बैर रखते हैं, उनके पितरों के दोष का दंड मैं उनकी सन्तान पर, तीसरी और चौथी पीढ़ी तक, लाता हूँ,
hi.R: उन्हें दंडवत मत करो और उनकी सेवा मत करो। मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारा परमेश्वर हूँ, और मैं जलन रखनेवाला परमेश्वर हूँ। मैं तुम्हारी वफ़ादारी किसी दूसरे देवता के साथ नहीं बाँटूँगा। जो लोग मुझसे बैर रखते हैं, उनके पाप का दंड मैं उनके पोतों और परपोतों तक को देता हूँ।

ru.L: Не будешь кланяться им и не будешь служить им, потому что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, — Бог ревнивый, посещающий беззаконие отцов на детях, и на третьем, и на четвёртом [поколении] ненавидящих {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}},
ru.B: Не преклоняйся перед ними и не служи им. Ведь {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, — Бог ревнивый. Я навожу вину отцов на детей, на третье и четвёртое поколение тех, кто ненавидит {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}},
ru.R: Не кланяйся им и не служи им. Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} Бог ревнивый. Я не стану делить твою верность с другими богами. Когда люди ненавидят {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} наказываю их грех даже в их внуках и правнуках.

uk.L: Не вклоняйся їм і не служи їм, бо я, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, — Бог ревнивий, що карає беззаконня батьків на дітях, і на третьому, і на четвертому [поколінні] тих, що ненавидять {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}},
uk.B: Не вклоняйся їм і не служи їм, бо я, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, — Бог ревнивий. Провину батьків я обертаю на їхніх дітей, на третє й четверте покоління тих, хто ненавидить {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}},
uk.R: Не вклоняйся їм і не служи їм. Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, і я ревнивий Бог. Я не ділитиму твоєї вірності з іншими богами. Коли люди ненавидять {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, я караю їхній гріх навіть у їхніх онуках і правнуках.

decisions.choice: jealous: passionate, demanding sole loyalty
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 20:5: a burning claim on one who belongs to you, like a husband's claim on his wife's faithfulness, not petty envy (4:24; 6:15).

decisions.choice: visiting iniquity to the third and fourth generation of those who hate me: judgment that reaches a family that keeps hating God
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 20:5. Three or four generations could live in one household, so the sin of its head reached all who lived under it. The law did not punish children for their parents' crimes in court (24:16). Here the Hebrew adds "and" before "the third", which does not change the sense.

decisions.choice: serve them: the verb has an unusual form
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 20:5, the vowels give a form that may mean "be led into serving them". The sense is the same: Israel must not worship idols.

decisions.choice: grandchildren and great-grandchildren
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 20:5: counting the fathers as the first generation, the third and fourth are their grandchildren and great-grandchildren. Readable also adds "I will not share your loyalty" to explain "jealous".

decisions.choice: "kỵ tà"
decisions.reason: The word settled for these books (see 4:24); a passion that demands sole loyalty (meaning decision). Exodus 20:5 uses the same word.

decisions.choice: "gian ác" (L); "tội" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's words for iniquity.

decisions.choice: "ከሚጠሉኝም በሦስተኛውና በአራተኛው" (and on the third and fourth) (L)
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy's Hebrew adds "and" before "the third", where Exodus 20:5 has none; Literal shows it with "-ም". Balanced and Readable keep the Amharic of Exodus 20:5, where the difference does not change the sense.

decisions.choice: "беззаконня" (L); "провина" (B)
decisions.reason: As the Old Testament terms note: iniquity is "беззаконня" at Literal and "провина" at Balanced and Readable; Readable follows the English "sin".

source.text: וְעֹ֥שֶׂהחֶ֖סֶדלַֽאֲלָפִ֑יםלְאֹהֲבַ֖י וּלְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י מִצְוֺתָֽי׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And doing covenant loyalty to thousands, to those who love me and to those who keep my commandments.

en.L: and doing steadfast love to thousands, to those who love {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and to those who keep {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} commandments.
en.B: but to thousands who love {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and keep {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} commandments I show faithful love.
en.R: But to thousands who love {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and obey {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} commands, I show faithful love.

es.L: y que obra con amor leal hacia millares, hacia los que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} aman y hacia los que guardan {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} mandamientos.
es.B: pero a millares de los que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} aman y cumplen {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} mandamientos les muestro {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} amor fiel.
es.R: Pero muestro {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} amor fiel a miles de personas que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} aman y obedecen {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} mandatos.

fr.L: et qui agit avec amour loyal envers des milliers, envers ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}aiment et envers ceux qui gardent {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} commandements.
fr.B: mais à des milliers de ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}aiment et gardent {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} commandements, je montre un amour fidèle.
fr.R: Mais je reste fidèle dans {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} amour envers des milliers de gens qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}aiment et qui obéissent à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} commandements.

sw.L: na ninayefanya upendo usiokoma kwa maelfu, kwa wale wanaonipenda na kwa wale wanaozishika amri {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}.
sw.B: lakini maelfu ya wale wanaonipenda na kutii amri {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} ninawaonyesha upendo wa uaminifu.
sw.R: Lakini maelfu ya watu wanaonipenda na kufuata amri {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}, ninawapenda kwa uaminifu bila kukoma.

ko.L: 그러나 나를 사랑하고 내 계명을 지키는 자들에게는 천 대까지 한결같은 사랑을 베푼다.
ko.B: 그러나 나를 사랑하고 내 계명을 지키는 사람들에게는 수천 대에 이르기까지 한결같은 사랑을 베푼다.
ko.R: 그러나 나를 사랑하고 내 명령을 지키는 사람들에게는 수천 대에 이르기까지 변함없는 사랑을 보여 준다.

vi.L: và làm ơn [bằng] tình yêu thương thành tín cho đến hàng ngàn [người], cho những người yêu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và những người giữ các điều răn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} tỏ tình yêu thương thành tín cho hàng ngàn người yêu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và giữ các điều răn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Nhưng với hàng ngàn người yêu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và vâng giữ các điều răn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} tỏ tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

pt.L: e faço lealdade a milhares, aos que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} amam e aos que guardam os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} mandamentos.
pt.B: mas aos milhares que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} amam e guardam os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} mandamentos eu mostro amor leal.
pt.R: Mas aos milhares que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} amam e obedecem aos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} mandamentos, eu mostro amor leal.

am.L: ለሺዎችም፣ ለሚወዱኝና ትእዛዛቴን ለሚጠብቁ፣ ጽኑ ፍቅርን የማደርግ [ነኝ]።
am.B: ነገር ግን ለሚወዱኝና ትእዛዛቴን ለሚጠብቁ ሺዎች ጽኑ ፍቅሬን አሳያለሁ።
am.R: ነገር ግን ለሚወዱኝና ትእዛዛቴን ለሚፈጽሙ ሺዎች ጽኑ ፍቅሬን አሳያለሁ።

hi.L: और जो मुझसे प्रेम रखते हैं और मेरी आज्ञाओं का पालन करते हैं, उन हज़ारों पर अटल प्रेम दिखाता हूँ।
hi.B: पर जो मुझसे प्रेम रखते हैं और मेरी आज्ञाओं को मानते हैं, उन हज़ारों पर मैं अटल प्रेम दिखाता हूँ।
hi.R: पर जो हज़ारों लोग मुझसे प्रेम रखते हैं और मेरी आज्ञाएँ मानते हैं, उन पर मैं अटल प्रेम दिखाता हूँ।

ru.L: и являющий неизменную любовь тысячам любящих {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} и соблюдающих {{deity_pronoun:мои|Мои}} заповеди.
ru.B: а тысячам тех, кто любит {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} и соблюдает {{deity_pronoun:мои|Мои}} заповеди, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} являю неизменную любовь.
ru.R: А к тысячам тех, кто любит {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} и исполняет {{deity_pronoun:мои|Мои}} заповеди, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} проявляю верную любовь.

uk.L: і чинить незмінну любов тисячам, тим, що люблять {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, і тим, що дотримуються {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} заповідей.
uk.B: а тисячам тих, хто любить {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}} й дотримується {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} заповідей, я виявляю незмінну любов.
uk.R: Але тисячам тих, хто любить {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}} і виконує {{deity_pronoun:мої|Мої}} заповіді, я виявляю вірну любов.

decisions.choice: my commandments: the reading the Hebrew text marks to be read
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the Hebrew text spell "his commandments", while the scribes' note in the margin says to read "my commandments", as in Exodus 20:6. The source data follows the marked reading. "His" would refer to God in the third person in the middle of God's own speech; "my" fits the context.

decisions.choice: thousands: thousands of people, or the thousandth generation
decisions.reason: Set against "the third and the fourth" generation in verse 9, the word may mean thousands of generations, as 7:9 says ("to a thousand generations"). Either way God's love far outlasts his judgment.

decisions.choice: steadfast love: loyal love that keeps covenant
decisions.reason: Kindness that stays true to a bond and acts on it (7:9, 12; Exodus 20:6; 34:6-7). Loving God is shown by keeping what he commands (6:5-6; 11:1).

decisions.choice: steadfast love (Literal); faithful love (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 20:6. Both stress loyalty; words such as "mercy" or "kindness" leave the loyalty out.

decisions.choice: "한결같은 사랑" (Literal, Balanced) and "변함없는 사랑" (Readable) for hesed
decisions.reason: As the Genesis and Psalms sheets set for hesed in Korean, and as the Korean Exodus 20:6 has it.

decisions.choice: "tình yêu thương thành tín" (L, B), "tình thương không hề thay đổi" (R); "hàng ngàn [người]"
decisions.reason: The forms the Genesis and Psalms notes give for hesed, loyal love that keeps covenant (meaning decision). The Hebrew says only "thousands", of people or of generations; Literal supplies "người" in brackets and the meaning decision gives the other reading.

decisions.choice: "अटल प्रेम" for hesed
decisions.reason: God's hesed is love that holds to the covenant (m1). As through the Pentateuch, Hindi says "अटल प्रेम" (unshakable love), here at every level, as in Exodus 20:6. The same through Deuteronomy.

decisions.choice: "неизменная любовь" (L, B); "верная любовь" (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole of Deuteronomy, as the Pentateuch note settles and as in Exodus 20:6: hesed is the loyal love that keeps covenant (m3). ¦

decisions.choice: "незмінна любов" (L, B); "вірна любов" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Old Testament terms note for *ḥesed*: the loyal love that keeps covenant (m3). Kept through the book.

source.text: לֹ֥א תִשָּׂ֛א אֶת־שֵֽׁם־יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לַשָּׁ֑וְא כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יְנַקֶּה֙ יְהוָ֔ה אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־יִשָּׂ֥א אֶת־שְׁמ֖וֹ לַשָּֽׁוְא׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Not you shall lift up [the] name of Yahweh your God to emptiness, for not will leave unpunished Yahweh [the one] who lifts up his name to emptiness.

en.L: You shall not lift up the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God to emptiness, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will not leave unpunished [the one] who lifts up {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name to emptiness.
en.B: You shall not use the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God for what is false or worthless, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will not let anyone go unpunished who uses {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name that way.
en.R: Do not use the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God in false promises or for empty purposes. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will punish anyone who treats {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name like that.

es.L: No alzarás el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios para la vanidad, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no declarará inocente al que alce {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre para la vanidad.
es.B: No usarás el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios para la mentira o para lo que no vale nada, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no dejará sin castigo a nadie que use así {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre.
es.R: No uses el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios en promesas falsas ni para cosas sin valor. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} castigará a cualquiera que trate {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre de esa manera.

fr.L: Tu ne lèveras pas le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu pour le vide, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne tiendra pas pour innocent celui qui lève {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom pour le vide.
fr.B: Tu n’utiliseras pas le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu pour le mensonge ou pour rien, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne laissera sans punition personne qui se sert ainsi de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom.
fr.R: N’utilise pas le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu dans de fausses promesses ou pour des choses vaines. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} punira toute personne qui traite {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom de cette façon.

sw.L: Hutaliinua jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako kwa ubatili, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hatamwacha bila adhabu yule aliinuaye jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} kwa ubatili.
sw.B: Hutalitumia jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako kwa uongo au kwa mambo yasiyo na maana, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hatamwachilia mtu yeyote anayelitumia jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} hivyo bila kumwadhibu.
sw.R: Usilitumie jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako katika ahadi za uongo au kwa mambo yasiyo na faida. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atamwadhibu kila mtu anayelitendea jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} hivyo.

ko.L: 너는 너의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 헛되이 들어 올리지 말라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 그분의 이름을 헛되이 들어 올리는 자를 벌하지 않고 두지 않으실 것이다.
ko.B: 너는 너의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 거짓되거나 헛된 일에 쓰지 말라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 그분의 이름을 그렇게 쓰는 사람을 벌하지 않고 그냥 두지 않으신다.
ko.R: 너의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 거짓 약속이나 쓸데없는 일에 쓰면 안 된다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 그분의 이름을 그렇게 함부로 쓰는 사람을 반드시 벌하신다.

vi.L: Ngươi chớ lấy danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi mà dùng cách hư không, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ không để cho [kẻ] lấy danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà dùng cách hư không khỏi bị phạt.
vi.B: Ngươi không được dùng danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi vào việc giả dối hay vô ích, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ không để cho ai dùng danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như thế mà khỏi bị phạt.
vi.R: Đừng dùng danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi để hứa dối hay vào những việc vô nghĩa. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ phạt bất cứ ai coi thường danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như thế.

pt.L: Não levantarás o nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, teu Deus, para o vazio, pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não deixará impune aquele que levantar o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome para o vazio.
pt.B: Não usarás o nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, teu Deus, para o que é falso ou sem valor, pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não deixará sem castigo quem usar o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome dessa maneira.
pt.R: Não uses o nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, teu Deus, em promessas falsas nem para coisas vazias. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vai castigar quem tratar o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome assim.

am.L: የአምላክህን {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ስም ለከንቱ አታንሣ፤ ስሙን ለከንቱ የሚያነሣውን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሳይቀጣ አይተወውምና።
am.B: የአምላክህን {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ስም ለሐሰት ወይም ለከንቱ ነገር አትጠቀምበት፤ ስሙን እንዲህ የሚጠቀምበትን ማንንም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሳይቀጣ አይተወውምና።
am.R: ሐሰተኛ ቃል ስትገባ ወይም ለከንቱ ነገር የአምላክህን {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ስም አትጥራ። ስሙን እንደዚያ የሚያደርገውን ሁሉ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይቀጣዋል።

hi.L: तुम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर का नाम व्यर्थ में नहीं उठाओगे, क्योंकि जो उनका नाम व्यर्थ में उठाता है, उसे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} निर्दोष न ठहराएँगे।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर का नाम झूठ या व्यर्थ बातों के लिए मत लो, क्योंकि जो कोई उनका नाम इस प्रकार लेता है, उसे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} दंड दिए बिना न छोड़ेंगे।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर का नाम झूठी शपथों में या बेकार कामों के लिए मत लो। जो कोई उनके नाम के साथ ऐसा व्यवहार करता है, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उसे दंड देंगे।

ru.L: Не будешь возносить имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, твоего Бога, впустую, потому что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} не оставит безнаказанным [того], кто возносит {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имя впустую.
ru.B: Не используй имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, твоего Бога, для лжи или пустого, потому что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} не оставит без наказания никого, кто так обращается с {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} именем.
ru.R: Не произноси имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, твоего Бога, в ложных клятвах или без нужды. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} накажет каждого, кто так обращается с {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} именем.

uk.L: Не підноси імені {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, твого Бога, на марноту, бо не залишить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} без кари [того], хто підносить {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} імʼя на марноту.
uk.B: Не вживай імені {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, твого Бога, для неправди чи марноти, бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} не залишить без кари того, хто так вживає {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} імʼя.
uk.R: Не можна вживати імені {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, твого Бога, у фальшивих обіцянках чи заради пустого. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} покарає кожного, хто так поводиться з {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} імʼям.

decisions.choice: lift up the name to emptiness: use God's name falsely or for nothing
decisions.reason: The same words as Exodus 20:7. To "lift up" the name is to speak it, above all in an oath (6:13; 10:20). "Emptiness" means what is false or worthless; verse 20 uses the same word of a witness. The command forbids swearing falsely by God's name and any use of it that treats it as empty.

decisions.choice: will not leave unpunished: will not acquit
decisions.reason: The verb means to declare clean or innocent. God will treat the one who misuses his name as guilty (Exodus 34:7).

decisions.choice: for what is false or worthless / in false promises or for empty purposes
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 20:7, Balanced and Readable spell out both senses of "emptiness". Literal keeps the picture.

decisions.choice: "lấy danh ... mà dùng cách hư không" (L)
decisions.reason: "lift up the name to emptiness" (meaning decision): Literal keeps "lấy" (take up) and "hư không" (emptiness); Balanced and Readable say what the misuse is, as the English does.
