records.literal_gloss: Keep the day of the Sabbath to make it holy, as commanded you Yahweh your God.

en.L: Keep the day of the Sabbath, to make it holy, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God commanded you.
en.B: Keep the Sabbath day and set it apart as holy, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God commanded you.
en.R: Keep the Sabbath day. Treat it as a holy day, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God commanded you.

es.L: Guarda el día del sábado, para hacerlo santo, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te ha mandado.
es.B: Guarda el día sábado y apártalo como santo, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te lo ha ordenado.
es.R: Guarda el sábado. Trátalo como un día santo, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te ha mandado.

fr.L: Garde le jour du sabbat, pour le rendre saint, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te l’a commandé.
fr.B: Garde le jour du sabbat et mets-le à part comme saint, ainsi que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te l’a ordonné.
fr.R: Garde le jour du sabbat. Traite-le comme un jour saint : c’est ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’a commandé.

sw.L: Shika siku ya Sabato, ili kuifanya takatifu, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako alivyokuamuru.
sw.B: Ishike siku ya Sabato na uitenge iwe takatifu, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako alivyokuamuru.
sw.R: Ishike siku ya Sabato. Iheshimu kama siku takatifu, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako alivyokuagiza.

ko.L: 안식일, 그날을 지켜 그것을 거룩하게 하라. 너의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너에게 명령하신 대로 하라.
ko.B: 너의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너에게 명령하신 대로 안식일을 지키고, 그날을 거룩한 날로 구별하라.
ko.R: 안식일을 지켜야 한다. 너의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너에게 명령하신 대로 그날을 거룩한 날로 지켜야 한다.

vi.L: Hãy giữ ngày Sa-bát để làm cho nó nên thánh, như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi đã truyền cho ngươi.
vi.B: Hãy giữ ngày Sa-bát và biệt riêng ngày ấy ra thánh, như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi đã truyền cho ngươi.
vi.R: Hãy giữ ngày Sa-bát. Hãy coi ngày ấy là ngày thánh, như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi đã truyền cho ngươi.

pt.L: Guarda o dia do sábado, para torná-lo santo, como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, teu Deus, te ordenou.
pt.B: Guarda o dia de sábado e separa-o como santo, como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, teu Deus, te ordenou.
pt.R: Guarda o dia de sábado. Trata-o como um dia santo, como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, teu Deus, te ordenou.

am.L: አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዳዘዘህ የሰንበትን ቀን ጠብቅ፤ ትቀድሰውም ዘንድ።
am.B: አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዳዘዘህ የሰንበትን ቀን ጠብቅ፤ ቅዱስ አድርገህም ለይተው።
am.R: የሰንበትን ቀን ጠብቅ። አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዳዘዘህ ቅዱስ ቀን አድርገህ ያዘው።

hi.L: सब्त के दिन को मानो, उसे पवित्र रखने के लिए, जैसी {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर ने तुम्हें आज्ञा दी है।
hi.B: सब्त के दिन को मानो और उसे पवित्र जानकर अलग रखो, जैसी {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर ने तुम्हें आज्ञा दी है।
hi.R: सब्त के दिन का पालन करो। उसे एक पवित्र दिन मानो, जैसी {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर ने तुम्हें आज्ञा दी है।

ru.L: Соблюдай день субботы, чтобы освятить его, как повелел тебе {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог.
ru.B: Соблюдай субботу и храни её как святой день, как повелел тебе {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог.
ru.R: Соблюдай субботу. Пусть она будет для тебя святым днём, как повелел тебе {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог.

uk.L: Дотримуйся дня суботнього, щоб святити його, як наказав тобі {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог.
uk.B: Дотримуйся суботнього дня й відокрем його як святий, як наказав тобі {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог.
uk.R: Дотримуйся суботи. Стався до неї як до святого дня, як наказав тобі {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог.

decisions.choice: keep: in place of "remember" in Exodus 20:8
decisions.reason: Exodus 20:8 begins "Remember the day of the Sabbath". Here the verb is "keep": to guard, watch over and carry out. It is the verb of verses 1, 10 and 29 and of the Sabbath law in Exodus 31:13-16. The two verbs do not disagree: to remember the day is to keep it. "Remember" comes back in verse 15, where Israel is to remember its slavery in Egypt.

decisions.choice: as Yahweh your God commanded you: pointing back to Horeb
decisions.reason: These words are not in Exodus 20:8. Moses is retelling the ten words forty years later, and he reminds the people that the command was already given at Horeb. The same words are added to the command about parents (verse 16).

decisions.choice: make it holy: set the day apart for God
decisions.reason: The day is to be treated as different from other days, belonging to Yahweh (Exodus 16:23; 20:8; 31:14).

decisions.choice: Keep
decisions.reason: "Keep" at every level, the same word used for keeping the commandments in verses 1, 10 and 29, so the reader can see the link.

decisions.choice: "Guarda" at every level (Exodus 20:8 "Recuerda")
decisions.reason: The same verb as "guardar" the commandments in verses 10 and 29, as the English keeps "Keep".

decisions.choice: "Garde" at every level (Exodus 20:8 "Souviens-toi")
decisions.reason: As the English keeps "Keep": the same verb as "garder" the commandments in verses 10 and 29, so the French reader sees the link and the difference from Exodus.

decisions.choice: "Shika" / "Ishike" at every level (Exodus 20:8 "Kumbuka")
decisions.reason: The same verb as "kuzishika" the commandments in verses 10 and 29, as the English keeps "Keep".

decisions.choice: "지키다" for "keep", where Exodus 20:8 has "기억하다" (remember)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision notes the change from Exodus; Korean marks it with a different verb so the reader comparing the two lists sees it.

decisions.choice: "Hãy giữ"
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy says "keep" where Exodus 20:8 says "remember" (meaning decision); Vietnamese keeps the difference, so that a reader comparing the two lists sees it.

decisions.choice: Guarda ... como o SENHOR, teu Deus, te ordenou
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy says "keep" where Exodus 20:8 says "remember" (m1), so "Lembra" becomes "Guarda" at every level: the verb Portuguese uses for keeping the commandments in verses 1, 10 and 29, as the English keeps "Keep" for the link (r-en-1). The added "como ... te ordenou" (m2) is new; the rest is Exodus 20:8.

decisions.choice: "ጠብቅ" (keep) for the Sabbath, in place of "አስታውስ" (remember) in Exodus 20:8
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy's Hebrew says "keep" where Exodus says "remember" (m1). "ጠብቅ" is the verb for keeping the commandments in verses 10, 29 and 32, so the link the English keeps is kept too. The added "as the LORD your God commanded you" is said with "እንዳዘዘህ", as in verse 16.

decisions.choice: "मानो" (keep, observe)
decisions.reason: Exodus 20:8 says "remember" the Sabbath day; Deuteronomy says "keep" (observe, guard) it, and adds "as the LORD your God commanded you". Hindi follows the difference, with "मानो" / "पालन करो" in place of Exodus' "स्मरण रखो" / "याद रखो".

decisions.choice: "Соблюдай"
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy says "keep" where Exodus says "remember" (m1); Russian follows the Hebrew and otherwise keeps the wording of Exodus 20:8. ¦

source.text: שֵׁ֤שֶׁתיָמִים֙תַּֽעֲבֹ֔דוְעָשִׂ֖יתָכָּלמְלַאכְתֶּֽךָ

records.literal_gloss: Six days you shall labor and you shall do all your work,

en.L: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,
en.B: You have six days to labor and do all your work,
en.R: You may work for six days and get all your jobs done.

es.L: Seis días te afanarás y harás todo tu trabajo,
es.B: Tienes seis días para trabajar y hacer todas tus tareas,
es.R: Puedes trabajar seis días y terminar todo lo que tengas que hacer.

fr.L: Six jours tu travailleras et tu feras tout ton ouvrage,
fr.B: Tu as six jours pour peiner et accomplir tout ton travail,
fr.R: Tu peux travailler pendant six jours et faire tout ce que tu as à faire.

sw.L: Siku sita utajishughulisha, na utafanya kazi yako yote,
sw.B: Una siku sita za kufanya kazi na kumaliza shughuli zako zote,
sw.R: Unaweza kufanya kazi kwa siku sita na kumaliza kazi zako zote.

ko.L: 엿새 동안 너는 일하고 네 모든 일을 할 것이다.
ko.B: 너는 엿새 동안 힘써 일하며 네 모든 일을 하라.
ko.R: 너는 엿새 동안 일하면서 네 일을 다 할 수 있다.

vi.L: Sáu ngày ngươi sẽ lao động và làm mọi công việc của ngươi,
vi.B: Ngươi có sáu ngày để lao động và làm mọi công việc của mình,
vi.R: Ngươi có thể làm việc trong sáu ngày và làm xong mọi công việc của mình.

pt.L: Seis dias labutarás e farás todo o teu trabalho,
pt.B: Tens seis dias para trabalhar e fazer todo o teu serviço,
pt.R: Podes trabalhar durante seis dias e fazer todas as tuas tarefas.

am.L: ስድስት ቀን ትደክማለህ፤ ሥራህንም ሁሉ ትሠራለህ፣
am.B: ለመሥራትና ሥራህን ሁሉ ለማከናወን ስድስት ቀን አለህ፤
am.R: ለስድስት ቀን መሥራትና ሥራህን ሁሉ መጨረስ ትችላለህ።

hi.L: छह दिन तुम परिश्रम करोगे और अपना सारा कामकाज करोगे,
hi.B: छह दिन तुम मेहनत करो और अपना सारा काम करो,
hi.R: छह दिन तुम काम कर सकते हो और अपने सब काम पूरे कर सकते हो।

ru.L: Шесть дней будешь трудиться и делать всю свою работу,
ru.B: У тебя есть шесть дней, чтобы трудиться и делать всю свою работу,
ru.R: Шесть дней ты можешь работать и делать все свои дела.

uk.L: Шість днів трудися і роби всю твою працю,
uk.B: Шість днів маєш ти, щоб трудитися й виконувати всю свою роботу,
uk.R: Шість днів ти можеш працювати й робити всі свої справи.

decisions.choice: labor and do all your work: six days are given to work
decisions.reason: The same words as Exodus 20:9. The verb "labor" is the one used for serving, including Israel's hard service in Egypt, which verse 15 will recall. There is time enough in six days for all the week's work.

source.text: וְי֨וֹם֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔ישַׁבָּ֖תלַיהוָ֣האֱלֹהֶ֑יךָלֹ֣א תַעֲשֶׂ֣ה כָל־מְלָאכָ֡ה אַתָּ֣ה וּבִנְךָֽ־וּבִתֶּ֣ךָ וְעַבְדְּךָֽ־וַ֠אֲמָתֶךָ וְשׁוֹרְךָ֨ וַחֲמֹֽרְךָ֜ וְכָל־בְּהֶמְתֶּ֗ךָ וְגֵֽרְךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּשְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ לְמַ֗עַן יָנ֛וּחַ עַבְדְּךָ֥ וַאֲמָתְךָ֖ כָּמֽוֹךָ

records.literal_gloss: And [the] day the seventh [is] a Sabbath to Yahweh your God; not you shall do any work, you and your son and your daughter and your male slave and your female slave and your ox and your donkey and all your livestock and your sojourner who [is] in your gates, so that may rest your male slave and your female slave like you.

en.L: but the seventh day [is] a Sabbath to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. You shall not do any work, you and your son and your daughter, and your male slave and your female slave, and your ox and your donkey and all your livestock, and your sojourner who [is] within your gates, so that your male slave and your female slave may rest like you.
en.B: but the seventh day is a Sabbath for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. Do no work on it: not you, nor your son or daughter, nor your male or female servant, nor your ox or your donkey or any of your livestock, nor the foreigner living among you in your towns, so that your male and female servants may rest as you do.
en.R: But the seventh day is a Sabbath, a day of rest for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. On that day no one in your household may work: not you, not your sons or daughters, not your servants, not your ox or donkey or any of your animals, and not the foreigners who live among you in your towns. Then your servants can rest, just as you do.

es.L: pero el día séptimo [es] sábado para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios. No harás ningún trabajo, tú y tu hijo y tu hija, y tu esclavo y tu esclava, y tu buey y tu asno y todo tu ganado, y tu inmigrante que [está] dentro de tus puertas, para que descansen tu esclavo y tu esclava como tú.
es.B: pero el séptimo día es un sábado para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios. Ese día no hagas ningún trabajo: ni tú, ni tu hijo o tu hija, ni tu siervo o tu sierva, ni tu buey, ni tu asno, ni ninguno de tus animales, ni el extranjero que vive contigo en tus ciudades, para que tu siervo y tu sierva descansen igual que tú.
es.R: Pero el séptimo día es el sábado, el día de descanso para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios. Ese día nadie en tu casa debe trabajar: ni tú, ni tus hijos o hijas, ni tus siervos, ni tu buey o tu burro, ni ninguno de tus animales, ni los extranjeros que viven contigo en tus ciudades. Así tus siervos podrán descansar, igual que tú.

fr.L: mais le septième jour [est] un sabbat {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu. Tu ne feras aucun ouvrage, toi, et ton fils, et ta fille, et ton esclave homme et ton esclave femme, et ton bœuf et ton âne et tout ton bétail, et ton immigré qui [est] dans tes portes, afin que ton esclave homme et ton esclave femme se reposent comme toi.
fr.B: mais le septième jour est un sabbat pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu. Ne fais aucun travail ce jour-là : ni toi, ni ton fils ou ta fille, ni ton serviteur ou ta servante, ni ton bœuf, ton âne ou aucune de tes bêtes, ni l’étranger qui vit chez toi, dans tes villes, afin que ton serviteur et ta servante se reposent comme toi.
fr.R: Mais le septième jour est un sabbat, un jour de repos pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu. Ce jour-là, personne dans ta maison ne doit travailler : ni toi, ni tes fils ou tes filles, ni tes serviteurs, ni ton bœuf, ni ton âne, ni aucun de tes animaux, ni les étrangers qui habitent avec toi dans tes villes. Ainsi tes serviteurs pourront se reposer, tout comme toi.

sw.L: lakini siku ya saba [ni] Sabato kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako. Hutafanya kazi yoyote, wewe na mwana wako na binti yako, na mtumwa wako wa kiume na mtumwa wako wa kike, na ng'ombe wako na punda wako na mifugo yako yote, na mgeni wako aliye katika malango yako, ili mtumwa wako wa kiume na mtumwa wako wa kike wapumzike kama wewe.
sw.B: lakini siku ya saba ni Sabato kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako. Siku hiyo usifanye kazi yoyote, iwe wewe, mwanao au binti yako, mtumishi wako wa kiume au wa kike, ng'ombe wako, punda wako au mifugo yako yoyote, au mgeni anayeishi nawe katika miji yako, ili mtumishi wako wa kiume na wa kike wapumzike kama wewe.
sw.R: Lakini siku ya saba ni Sabato, siku ya kupumzika kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako. Siku hiyo mtu yeyote wa nyumbani mwako asifanye kazi: wewe, watoto wako wa kiume na wa kike, watumishi wako, ng'ombe wako, punda wako na wanyama wako wote, hata wageni wanaoishi nawe katika miji yako. Hivyo watumishi wako nao wataweza kupumzika kama wewe.

ko.L: 그러나 일곱째 날은 너의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 안식일이다. 너는 아무 일도 하지 말라. 너와 네 아들과 네 딸과 네 남종과 네 여종과 네 소와 네 나귀와 네 모든 가축과 네 성문 안에 있는 네 나그네도 [그러하다]. 그리하여 네 남종과 네 여종도 너처럼 쉬게 하라.
ko.B: 그러나 일곱째 날은 너의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 바친 안식일이다. 그날에는 아무 일도 하지 말라. 너도, 네 아들이나 딸도, 네 남종이나 여종도, 네 소나 나귀나 그 밖의 어떤 가축도, 네 성읍 안에서 함께 사는 나그네도 일해서는 안 된다. 그래야 네 남종과 여종도 너처럼 쉴 수 있다.
ko.R: 그러나 일곱째 날은 너의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 안식일, 곧 쉬는 날이다. 그날에는 네 집안의 누구도 일하면 안 된다. 너도, 네 아들딸도, 네 종들도, 네 소나 나귀나 그 어떤 짐승도, 네 성읍에서 함께 사는 나그네도 일하면 안 된다. 그래야 네 종들도 너처럼 쉴 수 있다.

vi.L: nhưng ngày thứ bảy [là] ngày Sa-bát cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi. Ngươi chớ làm bất cứ công việc nào, ngươi, con trai ngươi, con gái ngươi, đầy tớ nam ngươi, đầy tớ nữ ngươi, bò ngươi, lừa ngươi, mọi súc vật ngươi, và ngoại kiều ở trong các cổng thành ngươi, để đầy tớ nam và đầy tớ nữ của ngươi được nghỉ ngơi như ngươi.
vi.B: nhưng ngày thứ bảy là ngày Sa-bát dành cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi. Ngày ấy ngươi không được làm công việc gì: không phải ngươi, không phải con trai hay con gái ngươi, không phải đầy tớ nam hay đầy tớ nữ của ngươi, không phải bò, lừa hay bất cứ súc vật nào của ngươi, cũng không phải ngoại kiều sống trong các thành của ngươi, để đầy tớ nam và đầy tớ nữ của ngươi cũng được nghỉ ngơi như ngươi.
vi.R: Nhưng ngày thứ bảy là ngày Sa-bát, một ngày nghỉ dành cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi. Ngày ấy không ai trong nhà ngươi được làm việc: không phải ngươi, không phải con trai con gái ngươi, không phải đầy tớ ngươi, không phải bò, lừa hay bất cứ con vật nào của ngươi, và cũng không phải những người nước ngoài sống giữa ngươi trong các thành của ngươi. Như vậy đầy tớ ngươi cũng được nghỉ ngơi như ngươi.

pt.L: mas o sétimo dia [é] sábado para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, teu Deus. Não farás trabalho algum, tu, nem o teu filho, nem a tua filha, nem o teu escravo, nem a tua escrava, nem o teu boi, nem o teu jumento, nem nenhum dos teus animais, nem o teu imigrante que [está] dentro das tuas portas, para que o teu escravo e a tua escrava descansem como tu.
pt.B: mas o sétimo dia é um sábado para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, teu Deus. Nesse dia não farás nenhum trabalho: nem tu, nem o teu filho ou a tua filha, nem o teu servo ou a tua serva, nem o teu boi ou o teu jumento ou qualquer dos teus animais, nem o estrangeiro que vive contigo nas tuas cidades, para que o teu servo e a tua serva descansem como tu.
pt.R: Mas o sétimo dia é um sábado, um dia de descanso para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, teu Deus. Nesse dia ninguém da tua casa deve trabalhar: nem tu, nem os teus filhos ou filhas, nem os teus servos, nem o teu boi ou o teu jumento ou qualquer dos teus animais, nem os estrangeiros que moram contigo nas tuas cidades. Assim os teus servos poderão descansar, como tu descansas.

am.L: ሰባተኛውም ቀን ሰንበት [ነው]፣ ለአምላክህ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}}፤ ምንም ሥራ አትሥራ፤ አንተ፣ ወንድ ልጅህና ሴት ልጅህ፣ ወንድ ባሪያህና ሴት ባሪያህ፣ በሬህና አህያህ፣ ከብትህም ሁሉ፣ በደጆችህ ውስጥ [ያለው] መጻተኛህም፤ ወንድ ባሪያህና ሴት ባሪያህ እንደ አንተ ያርፉ ዘንድ።
am.B: ሰባተኛው ቀን ግን ለአምላክህ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} የተለየ ሰንበት ነው። በዚያ ቀን ምንም ሥራ አትሥራ፤ አንተም ሆንክ ወንድ ወይም ሴት ልጅህ፣ ወንድ ወይም ሴት አገልጋይህ፣ በሬህ ወይም አህያህ ወይም ማንኛውም ከብትህ፣ ወይም በከተሞችህ ውስጥ ከአንተ ጋር የሚኖረው መጻተኛ፤ ይህም ወንድና ሴት አገልጋዮችህ እንደ አንተ እንዲያርፉ ነው።
am.R: ሰባተኛው ቀን ግን ሰንበት ነው፤ ለአምላክህ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} የተለየ የዕረፍት ቀን ነው። በዚያ ቀን በቤትህ ያለ ማንም ሰው አይሥራ፤ አንተም፣ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችህም፣ አገልጋዮችህም፣ በሬህና አህያህ ሌሎቹም እንስሶችህ ሁሉ፣ በከተሞችህ ውስጥ ከአንተ ጋር የሚኖሩ እንግዶችም አይሥሩ። ያን ጊዜ አገልጋዮችህ እንደ አንተ ያርፋሉ።

hi.L: परंतु सातवाँ दिन {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर के लिए सब्त [है]। तुम कोई काम नहीं करोगे, न तुम, न तुम्हारा पुत्र, न तुम्हारी पुत्री, न तुम्हारा दास, न तुम्हारी दासी, न तुम्हारा बैल, न तुम्हारा गधा, न तुम्हारा कोई पशु, न तुम्हारा परदेशी जो तुम्हारे फाटकों के भीतर [है], ताकि तुम्हारा दास और तुम्हारी दासी तुम्हारे समान विश्राम करें।
hi.B: पर सातवाँ दिन {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर के लिए सब्त है। उस दिन कोई काम मत करो: न तुम, न तुम्हारा पुत्र या पुत्री, न तुम्हारा दास या दासी, न तुम्हारा बैल या गधा या तुम्हारा कोई पशु, और न तुम्हारे नगरों में रहनेवाला परदेशी, ताकि तुम्हारे दास और दासी भी तुम्हारे समान विश्राम करें।
hi.R: पर सातवाँ दिन सब्त है, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर के लिए विश्राम का दिन। उस दिन तुम्हारे घर में कोई काम न करे: न तुम, न तुम्हारे बेटे-बेटियाँ, न तुम्हारे दास-दासियाँ, न तुम्हारा बैल या गधा या तुम्हारा कोई भी पशु, और न तुम्हारे नगरों में रहनेवाले परदेशी। तब तुम्हारे दास-दासियाँ भी तुम्हारी तरह आराम कर सकेंगे।

ru.L: а седьмой день — суббота {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, твоему Богу. Не будешь делать никакой работы, ни ты, ни твой сын, ни твоя дочь, ни твой раб, ни твоя рабыня, ни твой вол, ни твой осёл, ни всякий твой скот, ни твой пришелец, который в твоих воротах, чтобы отдохнули твой раб и твоя рабыня, как ты.
ru.B: а седьмой день — суббота для {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, твоего Бога. Не делай в этот день никакой работы: ни ты, ни твой сын, ни дочь, ни твой раб, ни рабыня, ни твой вол, ни осёл, ни какой-либо другой твой скот, ни пришелец, который живёт у тебя в твоих городах, чтобы твой раб и рабыня отдыхали так же, как ты.
ru.R: Но седьмой день — суббота, день отдыха для {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, твоего Бога. В этот день никто в твоём доме не должен работать: ни ты, ни твои сыновья и дочери, ни твои рабы и рабыни, ни твой вол или осёл, ни другие твои животные, ни чужеземцы, которые живут у тебя в твоих городах. Тогда твои рабы смогут отдохнуть так же, как ты.

uk.L: а сьомий день — субота для {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, твого Бога. Не роби жодної праці, ти, і твій син, і твоя дочка, і твій раб, і твоя рабиня, і твій віл, і твій осел, і вся твоя худоба, і твій приходько, що в твоїх брамах, щоб відпочив твій раб і твоя рабиня, як ти.
uk.B: а сьомий день — субота для {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, твого Бога. Не виконуй того дня жодної роботи: ні ти, ні твій син чи дочка, ні твій раб чи рабиня, ні твій віл, ні осел, ні будь-яка твоя худобина, ні приходько, що живе серед тебе в твоїх містах, щоб твій раб і твоя рабиня відпочивали так само, як ти.
uk.R: Але сьомий день — субота, день відпочинку для {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, твого Бога. Того дня ніхто у твоєму домі не може працювати: ні ти, ні твої сини чи дочки, ні твої раби, ні твій віл чи осел, ні інші твої тварини, ні чужинці, які живуть серед вас у твоїх містах. Тоді твої раби зможуть відпочити так само, як ти.

decisions.choice: your ox and your donkey ... so that your servants may rest like you: additions to Exodus 20:10
decisions.reason: Exodus 20:10 says "your livestock". Here the ox and the donkey, the animals that did the heaviest work, are named first, and "all your livestock" follows. The verse also gives a purpose that Exodus does not state: the rest is so that those who serve the household may rest just as its master does. Verse 15 gives the reason.

decisions.choice: male slave, female slave: workers owned by the household
decisions.reason: The words name men and women who belonged to the household and worked for it, owned, not hired (15:12-18; Exodus 21:2-11). The command is spoken to the head of the household, who must give the day to them as to himself.

decisions.choice: your sojourner within your gates: a foreigner living in your towns
decisions.reason: A sojourner is an outsider who has settled among Israel without land or family rights (10:18-19; 24:14). "Within your gates" means inside your town.

decisions.choice: male slave, female slave (Literal); servants (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The usual rule for this word: "slave" at Literal, "servant" at Balanced and Readable, with m2 saying what their position was. In verse 15, where Israel's own slavery in Egypt is the point, every level says "slave". Exodus 20:10 has "servant" at Literal for the same words; Deuteronomy follows the style guide here, so the Literal wording of the two Decalogues differs while the meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: the foreigner(s) living among you
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 20:10, Balanced and Readable say "foreigner living among you"; Literal keeps "sojourner". Readable also adds "a day of rest" to explain the word Sabbath.

decisions.choice: ton esclave homme et ton esclave femme (L); ton serviteur et ta servante (B, R)
decisions.reason: French "esclave" is the same for a man and a woman, so Literal adds "homme" and "femme" to keep the Hebrew pair apart. Balanced and Readable say "serviteur" and "servante", as the English says "servant".

decisions.choice: "남종" and "여종" (Readable "종들") for the male and female slaves of the household
decisions.reason: The term sheet keeps "종" for household servants and "노예" for slavery itself, as in Egypt in the next verse; the Korean Exodus 20:10 uses the same words.

decisions.choice: "đầy tớ nam", "đầy tớ nữ"; "ngoại kiều" (L, B), "người nước ngoài sống giữa ngươi" (R)
decisions.reason: Workers owned by the household (meaning decision); the term sheet keeps "đầy tớ" for them, as Exodus 20:10 does, and "nô lệ" for Israel's slavery in Egypt in verse 15.

decisions.choice: o teu boi, o teu jumento, (todos) os teus animais; para que ... descansem como tu
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy names the ox and the donkey before "all your livestock" and adds why the servants rest (m1); Portuguese adds these to the wording of Exodus 20:10 and keeps the rest. Balanced says "o estrangeiro que vive contigo", as Exodus's Readable does, where Exodus's Balanced has "entre vocês": in Deuteronomy no Balanced sentence mixes "tu" and "vocês" (4:1).

decisions.choice: Exodus 20:10 with Deuteronomy's additions: "በሬህና አህያህ" (your ox and your donkey), "ከብትህም ሁሉ" (all your livestock), and "... እንደ አንተ ያርፉ ዘንድ" (that ... may rest like you)
decisions.reason: The verse keeps the Amharic of Exodus 20:10 and adds only what Deuteronomy's Hebrew adds (m1). As there, the slaves are "ባሪያ" at Literal and "አገልጋይ" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: "दास", "दासी" at every level
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 20:10, the male and female slave are "दास" and "दासी" at every level; the English Balanced and Readable say "servants". Verse 15 recalls that Israel itself was a slave ("दास") in Egypt, which is the point of the command here.

decisions.choice: "раб", "рабыня" at every level
alternatives: "слуга", "служанка", as English Balanced and Readable say "servants"
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 20:10 in this translation and as the Pentateuch note settles, Russian keeps "раб" at every level; the point here is that slaves too must rest. ¦

decisions.choice: "раб", "рабиня" at every level
decisions.reason: As the Old Testament terms note, *ʿeved* is "раб" at every level; the point here is that the household's slaves rest too, so the word stays plain.

records.literal_gloss: And you shall remember that a slave you were in [the] land of Egypt, and brought you out Yahweh your God from there with a hand strong and with an arm outstretched; therefore commanded you Yahweh your God to do the day of the Sabbath.

en.L: And you shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God brought you out from there with a strong hand and with an outstretched arm; therefore {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God commanded you to observe the day of the Sabbath.
en.B: Remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God led you out from there by a strong hand and an outstretched arm. For this reason {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has commanded you to observe the Sabbath day.
en.R: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt, and that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God used {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} great power to bring you out of there. That is why {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.

es.L: Y recordarás que eras esclavo en la tierra de Egipto, y que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te hizo salir de allí con mano fuerte y con brazo extendido; por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te ordenó observar el día del sábado.
es.B: Recuerda que eras esclavo en el país de Egipto y que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te sacó de allí con mano poderosa y brazo extendido. Por esa razón {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te ha ordenado observar el día sábado.
es.R: Recuerda que eras esclavo en Egipto, y que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios usó {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gran poder para sacarte de allí. Por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te ha mandado guardar el sábado.

fr.L: Et tu te rappelleras que tu étais esclave dans le pays d’Égypte, et que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’a fait sortir de là par une main forte et par un bras étendu ; c’est pourquoi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’a commandé d’observer le jour du sabbat.
fr.B: Souviens-toi que tu étais esclave au pays d’Égypte, et que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’a fait sortir de là d’une main puissante et d’un bras étendu. Voilà pourquoi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’a ordonné d’observer le jour du sabbat.
fr.R: Souviens-toi que tu étais esclave en Égypte, et que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu s’est servi de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grande puissance pour t’en faire sortir. C’est pour cela que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’a commandé de garder le jour du sabbat.

sw.L: Nawe utakumbuka ya kuwa wewe ulikuwa mtumwa katika nchi ya Misri, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako alikutoa kutoka huko kwa mkono wenye nguvu na kwa mkono ulionyooshwa; ndiyo sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako amekuamuru kuiadhimisha siku ya Sabato.
sw.B: Kumbuka kwamba ulikuwa mtumwa katika nchi ya Misri, na kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako alikuleta nje kutoka huko kwa mkono hodari na kwa mkono ulionyooshwa. Kwa sababu hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako amekuamuru uiadhimishe siku ya Sabato.
sw.R: Kumbuka kwamba ulikuwa mtumwa huko Misri, na kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako alitumia nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} kuu kukutoa huko. Ndiyo maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako amekuamuru uishike siku ya Sabato.

ko.L: 너는 이집트 땅에서 노예였던 것과, 너의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 강한 손과 편 팔로 너를 거기서 이끌어 내신 것을 기억하라. 그러므로 너의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너에게 안식일을 지키라고 명령하셨다.
ko.B: 네가 이집트 땅에서 노예였다는 것과, 너의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 강한 손과 편 팔로 너를 거기서 이끌어 내셨다는 것을 기억하라. 그래서 너의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너에게 안식일을 지키라고 명령하셨다.
ko.R: 네가 이집트에서 노예였다는 것을 기억하여라. 너의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 큰 능력으로 너를 거기서 이끌어 내셨다. 그래서 너의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너에게 안식일을 지키라고 명령하셨다.

vi.L: Và ngươi phải nhớ rằng ngươi đã từng làm nô lệ trong xứ Ai Cập, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi đã đem ngươi ra khỏi đó bằng tay mạnh và cánh tay giơ ra; vì thế {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi đã truyền cho ngươi giữ ngày Sa-bát.
vi.B: Hãy nhớ rằng ngươi đã từng làm nô lệ trong đất Ai Cập, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi đã dùng tay quyền năng và cánh tay giơ ra mà đem ngươi ra khỏi đó. Vì thế {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi đã truyền cho ngươi phải giữ ngày Sa-bát.
vi.R: Hãy nhớ rằng ngươi đã từng làm nô lệ ở Ai Cập, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi đã dùng quyền năng lớn lao của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà đem ngươi ra khỏi đó. Vì thế {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi đã truyền cho ngươi phải giữ ngày Sa-bát.

pt.L: E lembrarás que foste escravo na terra do Egito, e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, teu Deus, te tirou de lá com mão forte e com braço estendido; por isso {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, teu Deus, te ordenou observar o dia do sábado.
pt.B: Lembra-te de que foste escravo na terra do Egito e de que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, teu Deus, te tirou de lá com mão forte e braço estendido. Por isso {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, teu Deus, te ordenou que observasses o dia de sábado.
pt.R: Lembra-te de que foste escravo no Egito e de que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, teu Deus, usou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} grande poder para te tirar de lá. É por isso que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, teu Deus, te mandou guardar o dia de sábado.

am.L: በግብፅ ምድር ባሪያ እንደ ነበርክ አስታውስ፤ አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም በብርቱ እጅና በተዘረጋ ክንድ ከዚያ አወጣህ፤ ስለዚህ አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሰንበትን ቀን ታከብር ዘንድ አዘዘህ።
am.B: በግብፅ ምድር ባሪያ እንደ ነበርክ፣ አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም በብርቱ እጅና በተዘረጋ ክንድ ከዚያ እንዳወጣህ አስታውስ። ስለዚህ አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሰንበትን ቀን እንድታከብር አዝዞሃል።
am.R: በግብፅ ባሪያ እንደ ነበርክ፣ አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም በታላቅ ኃይሉ ከዚያ እንዳወጣህ አስታውስ። አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሰንበትን ቀን እንድትጠብቅ ያዘዘህ ስለዚህ ነው።

hi.L: और स्मरण रखना कि तुम मिस्र देश में दास थे, और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारा परमेश्वर तुम्हें वहाँ से बलवंत हाथ और बढ़ाई हुई भुजा के द्वारा निकाल लाए; इसी कारण {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर ने तुम्हें सब्त के दिन को मानने की आज्ञा दी है।
hi.B: याद रखो कि तुम मिस्र देश में दास थे, और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारा परमेश्वर तुम्हें बलवंत हाथ और बढ़ाई हुई भुजा से वहाँ से निकाल लाए। इसी कारण {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर ने तुम्हें सब्त का दिन मानने की आज्ञा दी है।
hi.R: याद रखो कि तुम मिस्र में दास थे, और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारा परमेश्वर अपनी बड़ी शक्ति से तुम्हें वहाँ से निकाल लाए। इसी लिए {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर ने तुम्हें सब्त का दिन मानने की आज्ञा दी है।

ru.L: И помни, что ты был рабом в земле Египта и что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, вывел тебя оттуда рукой сильной и рукой простёртой; поэтому {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, повелел тебе соблюдать день субботы.
ru.B: Помни, что ты был рабом в земле Египта и что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, вывел тебя оттуда сильной рукой и простёртой рукой. Поэтому {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, и повелел тебе соблюдать субботний день.
ru.R: Помни, что ты был рабом в Египте и что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, своей великой силой вывел тебя оттуда. Вот почему {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, повелел тебе соблюдать субботу.

uk.L: І памʼятай, що рабом ти був у краю Єгипту, і вивів тебе {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, звідти рукою сильною і раменом простягнутим; тому наказав тобі {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, справляти день суботній.
uk.B: Памʼятай, що ти був рабом у єгипетській землі і що {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, вивів тебе звідти сильною рукою й простягнутим раменом. Ось чому {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, наказав тобі справляти суботній день.
uk.R: Памʼятай, що ти був рабом у Єгипті і що {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, вивів тебе звідти своєю великою силою. Ось чому {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, наказав тобі дотримуватися суботи.

decisions.choice: remember that you were a slave in Egypt: a different reason from Exodus 20:11
decisions.reason: In Exodus 20:11 the reason for the Sabbath is creation: God made the world in six days and rested on the seventh. Here the reason is the rescue from Egypt. A people once worked as slaves without rest, and set free by God, must give rest to those who work for them (verse 14; 15:15; 16:12; 24:18, 22). The two reasons stand side by side; neither cancels the other.

decisions.choice: a strong hand and an outstretched arm: God's power shown in the rescue
decisions.reason: The hand and the arm are pictures of strength in action. The pair describes the plagues and the crossing of the sea (4:34; 7:19; 26:8; Exodus 6:6).

decisions.choice: to do the day of the Sabbath: to observe it, to hold it as it should be held
decisions.reason: The verb is the ordinary word "do". With a festival or a holy day it means to keep or celebrate it (Exodus 31:16; Deuteronomy 16:1, 10).

decisions.choice: slave(s) at every level
decisions.reason: This is Israel's own slavery in Egypt, so "slave" stays at every level; the contrast with the servants of verse 14 is the point of the verse.

decisions.choice: used his great power
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of the hand and the arm (m2).

decisions.choice: "tu étais esclave" (singular) at every level; "observer" (L, B), "garder" (R) the Sabbath
decisions.reason: The Hebrew speaks to Israel as one ("you were a slave"), and French follows the Hebrew number even where the English Readable says "slaves". "Faire" the Sabbath (m3) is said "observer"; Readable uses "garder", as the English Readable says "keep".

decisions.choice: "강한 손과 편 팔" for "a strong hand and an outstretched arm"; Readable "큰 능력"
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the picture, which recurs through Deuteronomy; Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: observar o dia do sábado (L, B); guardar (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "do the day" means to hold it as it should be held (m3); Literal and Balanced say "observar", as the English says "observe", and Readable "guardar", as the English Readable says "keep". "Escravo" stays at every level for Israel's own slavery (r-en-1); the singular follows the Hebrew and "tu" of the commandments, where the English Readable says "slaves".

decisions.choice: "አስታውስ" (remember) for Israel's slavery, the reason for the Sabbath in place of Exodus 20:11
decisions.reason: Exodus 20:11 grounds the Sabbath in creation; Deuteronomy grounds it in the rescue from Egypt (m1). Amharic uses "አስታውስ", the verb of Exodus 20:8, so the reader hears that what Israel is to remember has moved from the day to the slavery. "በብርቱ እጅና በተዘረጋ ክንድ" (a strong hand and an outstretched arm) is kept at Literal and Balanced, as in Exodus; Readable says "በታላቅ ኃይሉ" (by his great power).

source.text: כַּבֵּ֤ד אֶת־אָבִ֨יךָ֙ וְאֶת־אִמֶּ֔ךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוְּךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לְמַ֣עַן׀יַאֲרִיכֻ֣ן יָמֶ֗יךָ וּלְמַ֨עַן֙ יִ֣יטַב לָ֔ךְ עַ֚ל הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽךְ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Honor your father and your mother, as commanded you Yahweh your God, so that may be long your days and so that it may go well with you on the land which Yahweh your God [is] giving to you.

en.L: Honor your father and your mother, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God commanded you, so that your days may be long, and so that it may go well with you upon the land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is giving to you.
en.B: Honor your father and your mother, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has commanded you. Then your days will be long, and it will go well with you in the land {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is going to give you.
en.R: Honor your father and your mother, and treat them with respect, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has commanded you. Then you will enjoy a long life, and things will go well for you in the land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is about to give you.

es.L: Honra a tu padre y a tu madre, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te ha mandado, para que tus días sean largos y para que te vaya bien sobre el suelo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te está dando.
es.B: Honra a tu padre y a tu madre, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te ha ordenado. Así tus días serán largos, y te irá bien en la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios va a darte.
es.R: Honra a tu padre y a tu madre, y trátalos con respeto, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te ha mandado. Así vivirás muchos años, y te irá bien en la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios está a punto de darte.

fr.L: Honore ton père et ta mère, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te l’a commandé, afin que tes jours soient longs et afin que tout aille bien pour toi sur le sol que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te donne.
fr.B: Honore ton père et ta mère, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te l’a commandé. Ainsi tes jours dureront longtemps, et tout ira bien pour toi dans le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu va te donner.
fr.R: Honore ton père et ta mère, et traite-les avec respect, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te l’a commandé. Alors tu profiteras d’une longue vie, et tout ira bien pour toi dans le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu est sur le point de te donner.

sw.L: Waheshimu baba yako na mama yako, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako alivyokuamuru, ili siku zako zirefuke, na ili upate mema juu ya ardhi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakupa.
sw.B: Waheshimu baba yako na mama yako, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako alivyokuamuru. Ndipo utaishi muda mrefu, na mambo yatakuendea vema katika nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako atakupa.
sw.R: Waheshimu baba yako na mama yako, na uwatendee kwa adabu, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako alivyokuamuru. Ndipo utafurahia maisha marefu, na mambo yatakuendea vizuri katika nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakaribia kukupa.

ko.L: 너의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너에게 명령하신 대로 네 아버지와 네 어머니를 공경하라. 그러면 너의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너에게 주시는 땅에서 네 날이 길고 네가 잘될 것이다.
ko.B: 너의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너에게 명령하신 대로 네 아버지와 어머니를 공경하라. 그러면 너의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너에게 주실 땅에서 네가 오래 살고 잘될 것이다.
ko.R: 너의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너에게 명령하신 대로 네 아버지와 어머니를 공경하고 존중해야 한다. 그러면 너의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 곧 너에게 주실 땅에서 네가 오래오래 살고 모든 일이 잘될 것이다.

vi.L: Hãy hiếu kính cha ngươi và mẹ ngươi, như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi đã truyền cho ngươi, để ngày [đời] ngươi được lâu dài, và để ngươi được phước trên đất mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi ban cho ngươi.
vi.B: Hãy hiếu kính cha mẹ ngươi, như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi đã truyền cho ngươi. Như vậy ngươi sẽ được sống lâu và được phước trong xứ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi sắp ban cho ngươi.
vi.R: Hãy hiếu kính cha mẹ ngươi và tôn trọng họ, như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi đã truyền cho ngươi. Như vậy ngươi sẽ được sống lâu, và mọi việc sẽ tốt đẹp cho ngươi trong xứ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi sắp ban cho ngươi.

pt.L: Honra o teu pai e a tua mãe, como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, teu Deus, te ordenou, para que os teus dias sejam longos, e para que te vá bem sobre a terra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, teu Deus, está te dando.
pt.B: Honra o teu pai e a tua mãe, como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, teu Deus, te ordenou. Assim terás vida longa, e tudo te irá bem na terra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, teu Deus, vai te dar.
pt.R: Honra o teu pai e a tua mãe e trata-os com respeito, como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, teu Deus, te ordenou. Então viverás muitos anos, e tudo vai dar certo para ti na terra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, teu Deus, está para te dar.

am.L: አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዳዘዘህ አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር፤ ቀኖችህ ይረዝሙ ዘንድ፣ አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በሚሰጥህ ምድር ላይም መልካም ይሆንልህ ዘንድ።
am.B: አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዳዘዘህ አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር። እንዲህ ብታደርግ ዕድሜህ ይረዝማል፤ አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሊሰጥህ ባለው ምድርም መልካም ይሆንልሃል።
am.R: አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዳዘዘህ አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር፤ በአክብሮትም ያዛቸው። ያን ጊዜ ረጅም ዘመን ትኖራለህ፤ አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሊሰጥህ ባለው ምድርም ነገር ሁሉ መልካም ይሆንልሃል።

hi.L: अपने पिता और अपनी माता का सम्मान करो, जैसी {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर ने तुम्हें आज्ञा दी है, ताकि जो देश {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारा परमेश्वर तुम्हें दे रहे हैं, उसमें तुम्हारे दिन लंबे हों और तुम्हारा भला हो।
hi.B: अपने पिता और अपनी माता का सम्मान करो, जैसी {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर ने तुम्हें आज्ञा दी है। तब जो देश {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारा परमेश्वर तुम्हें देनेवाले हैं, उसमें तुम्हारी आयु लंबी होगी और तुम्हारा भला होगा।
hi.R: अपने पिता और माता का आदर करो, और उनके साथ सम्मान से व्यवहार करो, जैसी {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर ने तुम्हें आज्ञा दी है। तब तुम उस देश में लंबी उम्र पाओगे और तुम्हारा भला होगा, जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारा परमेश्वर तुम्हें देनेवाले हैं।

ru.L: Почитай твоего отца и твою мать, как повелел тебе {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, чтобы долгими были твои дни и чтобы хорошо было тебе на земле, которую {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, даёт тебе.
ru.B: Почитай своего отца и свою мать, как повелел тебе {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог. Тогда ты будешь долго жить и тебе будет хорошо в земле, которую {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, даст тебе.
ru.R: Почитай своего отца и свою мать и относись к ним с уважением, как повелел тебе {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог. Тогда ты будешь долго жить и у тебя всё будет хорошо в земле, которую {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, скоро даст тебе.

uk.L: Шануй твого батька і твою матір, як наказав тобі {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, щоб довгими були твої дні і щоб було добре тобі на землі, яку {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, дає тобі.
uk.B: Віддавай шану батькові й матері, як наказав тобі {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог. Тоді ти довго житимеш, і буде тобі добре на землі, яку {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, тобі дасть.
uk.R: Шануй батька й матір і стався до них з повагою, як наказав тобі {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог. Тоді ти житимеш довго, і тобі буде добре в краю, який {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, скоро тобі дасть.

decisions.choice: as Yahweh commanded you ... and so that it may go well with you: additions to Exodus 20:12
decisions.reason: Exodus 20:12 promises long life in the land. Here the command again points back to Horeb (as in verse 12), and a second promise is added: "that it may go well with you", a phrase Deuteronomy uses often (4:40; 6:3, 18; 22:7). Ephesians 6:2-3 quotes the command with this added promise.

decisions.choice: honor: give weight to, respect and care for
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 20:12. To honor parents is to treat them as weighty: to respect, obey and care for them all their lives (21:18-21; 27:16).

decisions.choice: the land: the ground of Canaan that God is giving
decisions.reason: The word is the one for soil and farmland. The promise is a long and good life in the land Israel is about to enter (4:40; 11:9).

decisions.choice: "hiếu kính"
decisions.reason: To honor is to respect and care for (meaning decision); "hiếu kính" is that duty of a child to parents, as in Exodus 20:12.

decisions.choice: está te dando (L); vai te dar (B); está para te dar (R)
decisions.reason: The commandment keeps the wording of Exodus 20:12 for the land God is giving, as the English does at each level, rather than the book's usual "te dá"; the added "como ... te ordenou" and "para que te vá bem" (m1) are new.

decisions.choice: "መልካም ይሆንልህ ዘንድ" (that it may go well with you), as in Ephesians 6:3
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy adds "as the LORD your God commanded you" and "that it may go well with you" to Exodus 20:12 (m1). The command itself keeps "አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር" of Exodus 20:12 and Ephesians 6:2, and the added promise takes the wording of Ephesians 6:3, which quotes this verse.

decisions.choice: murder: the unlawful killing of a person
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 20:13. This verb is used only of killing a human being, by intent or by careless violence (4:41-42; 19:4-6; Numbers 35:16-21), and never of killing in battle. The law itself sets the death penalty for some crimes (19:11-13), so the command forbids unlawful killing.

decisions.choice: the verse division follows the source data
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 20, the Hebrew text of the ten words carries two sets of accents, and Hebrew Bibles that follow the second set may join verses 17-20 into a single verse. The source data numbers them as four verses, so the verse numbers of this chapter are the same as in the usual numbering of translations, and no shift in numbering needs to be noted here.

decisions.choice: and: the last commands are joined into one chain
decisions.reason: In Exodus 20:14-17 each of the last four commands stands on its own. Here each begins with "and" (verses 18-21), linking them as one series of duties toward one's neighbor.

decisions.choice: commit adultery: sexual union that breaks a marriage
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 20:14: sexual relations between a married or betrothed woman and a man who is not her husband, and both were guilty (22:22-24).

decisions.choice: no "and" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "And" at the start of verses 18-21 to show the chain (m1); in Balanced and Readable a list of commands reads more naturally without it.

decisions.choice: "አታመንዝርም", "አትስረቅም", "በባልንጀራህም", "የባልንጀራህንም" (L): the "and" of verses 18-21
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy joins the last commands with "and" (m1). Literal shows it with the suffix "-ም" (and, also), which keeps the commands short; Balanced and Readable keep the bare commands of Exodus 20:14-17.

decisions.choice: a witness of emptiness: in place of "a witness of falsehood" in Exodus 20:16
decisions.reason: Exodus 20:16 has the word for a lie. Here the word is "emptiness", the same as in verse 11 ("lift up the name to emptiness"): testimony that is groundless, worthless, false. It forbids not only an outright lie but any evidence with nothing behind it. The use of the same word links misuse of God's name and misuse of a neighbor's case.

decisions.choice: answer as a witness: testify in court
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 20:16, to "answer" is the word for giving evidence in a case. A false witness was to suffer what he meant to bring on the other (19:16-19).

decisions.choice: neighbor: a fellow member of the community
decisions.reason: The word means the person beside you: a fellow Israelite, anyone you deal with.

decisions.choice: baseless evidence / false or empty things
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable keep the difference from Exodus 20:16 (m1): the testimony is empty, without ground. Literal keeps "a witness of emptiness".

decisions.choice: testigo de vanidad (L); un testimonio sin fundamento (B)
decisions.reason: Literal uses the same word as "para la vanidad" in verse 11, not the "mentira" of Exodus 20:16.

decisions.choice: témoin de vide (L); un témoignage sans fondement (B)
decisions.reason: Literal uses the same word as "pour le vide" in verse 11, so the link between the two commands shows, and not the "mensonge" of Exodus 20:16.

decisions.choice: shahidi wa ubatili (L); ushahidi usio na msingi (B)
decisions.reason: Literal uses the same word as "kwa ubatili" in verse 11, not the "uongo" of Exodus 20:16.

decisions.choice: "헛된 증인" (Literal), "근거 없는 증언" (Balanced) for "a witness of emptiness"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision notes that this differs from "a witness of falsehood" in Exodus 20:16, where the Korean has "거짓"; Korean keeps the difference.

decisions.choice: "hư không" (L); "vô căn cứ" (B)
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy says "a witness of emptiness" where Exodus 20:16 says "of falsehood" (meaning decision); Literal keeps "hư không", and Balanced "vô căn cứ", testimony with nothing behind it.

decisions.choice: testemunha vazia (L); testemunho sem fundamento (B); coisas falsas ou vazias (R)
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy has "emptiness" where Exodus 20:16 has "falsehood" (m1), the word of verse 11 ("para o vazio"), so Portuguese changes only that word from Exodus at each level.

decisions.choice: "የከንቱ ምስክር" (a witness of emptiness) (L); "መሠረት የሌለው ምስክርነት" (baseless testimony) (B); "ሐሰትን ወይም ከንቱ ነገርን" (R)
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy's Hebrew has the word of verse 11, "emptiness", where Exodus 20:16 has "falsehood" (m1). Literal uses "ከንቱ", the word of verse 11; Balanced and Readable say what empty testimony is. The rest of the command keeps the Amharic of Exodus 20:16.

decisions.choice: "व्यर्थ की गवाही" (L), "निराधार गवाही" (B)
decisions.reason: Exodus 20:16 speaks of a "false" witness; Deuteronomy uses the word of the third commandment, "emptiness", a witness with nothing true behind it. Hindi follows the difference, and Literal uses "व्यर्थ" as in verse 11.

decisions.choice: "пустой свидетель" (L); "необоснованные показания" (B); "ложное или пустое" (R)
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy says "a witness of emptiness" where Exodus says "a witness of falsehood" (m1), so the wording differs from Exodus 20:16 here. ¦

records.literal_gloss: And not you shall covet [the] wife of your neighbor; and not you shall desire [the] house of your neighbor, his field and his male slave and his female slave, his ox and his donkey and all that [belongs] to your neighbor.

en.L: And you shall not covet the wife of your neighbor; and you shall not desire the house of your neighbor, his field, or his male slave, or his female slave, his ox, or his donkey, or anything that [belongs] to your neighbor.'
en.B: You shall not covet your neighbor's wife. You shall not crave your neighbor's house, his field, his male or female servant, his ox or his donkey, or anything else your neighbor has.'
en.R: Do not set your heart on your neighbor's wife. Do not long to have his house, his field, his servants, his ox or donkey, or anything else that belongs to him.'

es.L: Y no codiciarás la esposa de tu prójimo; y no desearás la casa de tu prójimo, su campo, o su esclavo, o su esclava, su buey, o su asno, o cualquier cosa que [pertenezca] a tu prójimo.”
es.B: No codiciarás la esposa de tu prójimo. No ansiarás la casa de tu prójimo, ni su campo, ni su siervo o su sierva, ni su buey o su asno, ni nada más que tenga tu prójimo.”
es.R: No pongas los ojos en la esposa de tu prójimo. No anheles tener su casa, su campo, sus siervos, su buey o su burro, ni ninguna otra cosa que le pertenezca.”

fr.L: Et tu ne convoiteras pas la femme de ton prochain ; et tu ne désireras pas la maison de ton prochain, son champ, ou son esclave homme, ou son esclave femme, son bœuf, ou son âne, ou quoi que ce soit qui [appartient] à ton prochain.”
fr.B: Tu ne convoiteras pas la femme de ton prochain. Tu ne désireras pas avidement la maison de ton prochain, son champ, son serviteur ou sa servante, son bœuf ou son âne, ni rien d’autre de ce qu’il possède.”
fr.R: Ne cherche pas à avoir la femme de ton prochain. N’aie pas envie d’avoir sa maison, son champ, ses serviteurs, son bœuf ou son âne, ni rien d’autre qui lui appartient.”

sw.L: Wala hutamtamani mke wa jirani yako; wala hutaionea shauku nyumba ya jirani yako, shamba lake, au mtumwa wake wa kiume, au mtumwa wake wa kike, ng'ombe wake, au punda wake, au chochote [kilicho] cha jirani yako.'
sw.B: Usimtamani mke wa jirani yako. Usiwe na uchu wa nyumba ya jirani yako, shamba lake, mtumishi wake wa kiume au wa kike, ng'ombe wake au punda wake, wala kitu kingine chochote ambacho ni mali ya jirani yako.'
sw.R: Usimmezee mate mke wa jirani yako. Usiwe na hamu ya kupata nyumba yake, shamba lake, watumishi wake, ng'ombe wake au punda wake, wala kitu kingine chochote ambacho ni chake.'

ko.L: 그리고 너는 네 이웃의 아내를 탐내지 말라. 그리고 너는 네 이웃의 집이나, 그의 밭이나, 그의 남종이나, 그의 여종이나, 그의 소나, 그의 나귀나, 네 이웃에게 속한 어떤 것도 갖고 싶어 하지 말라.'
ko.B: 너는 네 이웃의 아내를 탐내지 말라. 네 이웃의 집이나 밭이나 남종이나 여종이나 소나 나귀나, 그 밖에 네 이웃의 것은 무엇이든 갖고 싶어 하지 말라.'
ko.R: 네 이웃의 아내에게 마음을 두면 안 된다. 네 이웃의 집이나 밭이나 종들이나 소나 나귀나, 그 밖에 이웃의 것은 무엇이든 가지려고 하면 안 된다.'

vi.L: Và ngươi chớ tham muốn vợ của người lân cận ngươi; và ngươi chớ thèm muốn nhà của người lân cận ngươi, ruộng của người, đầy tớ nam của người, đầy tớ nữ của người, bò của người, lừa của người, hay bất cứ vật gì [thuộc về] người lân cận ngươi.'
vi.B: Ngươi không được tham muốn vợ của người lân cận. Ngươi không được thèm muốn nhà của người lân cận, ruộng đất, đầy tớ nam hay đầy tớ nữ, bò hay lừa của người, hay bất cứ vật gì khác của người lân cận ngươi.'
vi.R: Đừng để lòng mình ham muốn vợ của người lân cận. Đừng ao ước chiếm lấy nhà của người ấy, ruộng đất, đầy tớ, bò hay lừa của người, hay bất cứ vật gì khác thuộc về người ấy.'

pt.L: E não cobiçarás a esposa do teu próximo; e não desejarás a casa do teu próximo, o campo dele, nem o escravo dele, nem a escrava dele, o boi dele, nem o jumento dele, nem nada que [seja] do teu próximo.'
pt.B: Não cobiçarás a mulher do teu próximo. Não desejarás para ti a casa do teu próximo, nem o campo dele, nem o seu servo ou a sua serva, nem o seu boi ou o seu jumento, nem nada mais que o teu próximo tenha.'
pt.R: Não queiras tomar para ti a mulher do teu próximo. Não desejes ter a casa dele, o campo dele, os seus servos, o seu boi, o seu jumento, nem qualquer outra coisa que pertença a ele.'

am.L: የባልንጀራህንም ሚስት አትመኝ፤ የባልንጀራህንም ቤት፣ እርሻውን፣ ወንድ ባሪያውንም፣ ሴት ባሪያውንም፣ በሬውንም፣ አህያውንም፣ የባልንጀራህ የሆነውንም ሁሉ አትጓጓ።”
am.B: የባልንጀራህን ሚስት አትመኝ። የባልንጀራህን ቤት፣ እርሻውን፣ ወንድ ወይም ሴት አገልጋዩን፣ በሬውን ወይም አህያውን፣ ወይም ባልንጀራህ ያለውን ማንኛውንም ነገር ለማግኘት አትጓጓ።”
am.R: የባልንጀራህን ሚስት የራስህ ለማድረግ አትመኝ። ቤቱን፣ እርሻውን፣ አገልጋዮቹን፣ በሬውን ወይም አህያውን፣ ወይም የእርሱ የሆነውን ማንኛውንም ነገር ለማግኘት አትጓጓ።”

hi.L: और तुम अपने पड़ोसी की पत्नी का लालच नहीं करोगे; और तुम अपने पड़ोसी के घर का, उसके खेत का, या उसके दास का, या उसकी दासी का, उसके बैल का, या उसके गधे का, या किसी भी वस्तु का जो तुम्हारे पड़ोसी की [है], लोभ नहीं करोगे।'
hi.B: अपने पड़ोसी की पत्नी का लालच मत करो। अपने पड़ोसी के घर, उसके खेत, उसके दास या दासी, उसके बैल या गधे, या अपने पड़ोसी की किसी भी वस्तु पर मन मत लगाओ।'
hi.R: अपने पड़ोसी की पत्नी को पाने पर मन मत लगाओ। उसके घर, उसके खेत, उसके दास-दासियों, उसके बैल या गधे, या उसकी किसी भी चीज़ को पाने की इच्छा मत करो।'

ru.L: И не будешь желать жены твоего ближнего; и не будешь домогаться дома твоего ближнего, его поля, ни его раба, ни его рабыни, ни его вола, ни его осла, ни всего, что [принадлежит] твоему ближнему.”
ru.B: Не желай заполучить жену своего ближнего. Не стремись завладеть домом своего ближнего, его полем, его рабом или рабыней, его волом или ослом или чем-нибудь другим, что есть у твоего ближнего.”
ru.R: Не мечтай забрать себе жену своего ближнего. Не желай отнять у него его дом, поле, рабов, вола или осла или что-нибудь другое, что ему принадлежит.”

uk.L: І не жадай жінки твого ближнього; і не бажай дому твого ближнього, його поля, і його раба, і його рабині, його вола, і його осла, і всього, що [належить] твоєму ближньому.”
uk.B: Не жадай жінки свого ближнього. Не прагни мати дім свого ближнього, його поле, його раба чи рабиню, його вола чи осла, чи будь-що інше, що має твій ближній.”
uk.R: Не прагни заволодіти жінкою свого ближнього. Не бажай мати його дім, його поле, його рабів, його вола чи осла, чи будь-що інше, що йому належить.”

decisions.choice: the wife first, then the house and field: a different order from Exodus 20:17
decisions.reason: In Exodus 20:17 "your neighbor's house" comes first and the wife is named within the household that follows. Here the wife stands alone in the first clause, and the house begins a second list of property. The field is added, fitting a people about to receive land of their own (verse 31).

decisions.choice: covet ... desire: two verbs for wanting what is another's
decisions.reason: The first verb, as in Exodus 20:17, means to desire something in a way that leads to taking it (7:25; Joshua 7:21). The second, used here in place of Exodus's second "covet", means to long for or crave, a hunger of the appetite (Numbers 11:4). Both reach the heart, where the other wrongs begin.

decisions.choice: one command or two
decisions.reason: Because the wife and the house stand in separate clauses here, one ancient way of counting the ten words, followed in Catholic and Lutheran tradition, takes the coveting of the wife and the coveting of property as two commands, and counts verses 7-10 as one (see verse 6).

decisions.choice: the end of God's words
decisions.reason: God's words that began in verse 6 end here. Verse 22 returns to Moses' account of the events.

decisions.choice: covet ... desire (Literal); covet ... crave (Balanced); set your heart on ... long to have (Readable)
decisions.reason: Each level uses two different words, since the Hebrew does. As in verse 14, the servants are "slave" at Literal and "servant" at Balanced and Readable. Exodus 20:17 has "servant" at Literal; the difference is one of wording only (see verse 14).

decisions.choice: codiciar ... desear (L); codiciar ... ansiar (B); poner los ojos en ... anhelar tener (R)
decisions.reason: Two different verbs at each level, since the Hebrew has two (m2), where Exodus 20:17 repeats "codiciar".

decisions.choice: convoiter ... désirer (L); convoiter ... désirer avidement (B); chercher à avoir ... avoir envie d'avoir (R)
decisions.reason: Two different verbs at each level, since the Hebrew has two (m2), where Exodus 20:17 repeats "convoiter".

decisions.choice: kutamani ... kuionea shauku (L); kutamani ... kuwa na uchu wa (B); kumezea mate ... kuwa na hamu ya kupata (R)
decisions.reason: Two different verbs at each level, since the Hebrew has two (m2), where Exodus 20:17 repeats "kutamani".

decisions.choice: "탐내다" and "갖고 싶어 하다" (Readable "마음을 두다" and "가지려고 하다") for the two verbs "covet" and "desire"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision notes two different verbs here, where Exodus 20:17 has one; Korean keeps them apart.

decisions.choice: "tham muốn" ... "thèm muốn" (L, B); "ham muốn" ... "ao ước chiếm lấy" (R)
decisions.reason: Two verbs for wanting what is another's (meaning decision); Vietnamese keeps two words as the Hebrew does, the first the word of Romans 7:7.

decisions.choice: the wife first, then "e não desejarás" the house and the field
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy names the wife first and alone, begins a second clause with a second verb for the house, and adds the field (m1, m2). Portuguese moves the words of Exodus 20:17 into that order: "cobiçar" for the first verb at Literal and Balanced and "desejar" for the second at every level, as Exodus already uses them; "E" opens verses 18-21 at Literal only (r-en-1 on verse 18).

decisions.choice: "አትመኝ" (covet) for the wife; "አትጓጓ" (do not crave) for the house and all else
alternatives: "ዓይንህን አትጣልበት", the Balanced idiom of Exodus 20:17
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy puts the wife first and gives her her own verb, "covet", the verb of Exodus 20:17, which keeps "አትመኝ" (as in Romans 13:9). The house, now joined by the field, takes a second verb, "desire" (m2), given as "አትጓጓ" at every level, so the two verbs stay distinct as they are in the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "желать ... домогаться" (L); "желать заполучить ... стремиться завладеть" (B); "мечтать забрать ... желать отнять" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses two verbs here (m2), and puts the wife first (m1). Russian keeps the two verbs apart and follows the order of Deuteronomy. ¦

source.text: אֶֽת־הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֡לֶּה דִּבֶּר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֶל־כָּל־קְהַלְכֶ֜ם בָּהָ֗ר מִתּ֤וֹךְ הָאֵשׁ֙ הֶֽעָנָ֣ן וְהָֽעֲרָפֶ֔ל ק֥וֹל גָּד֖וֹל וְלֹ֣א יָסָ֑ף וַֽיִּכְתְּבֵ֗ם עַל־שְׁנֵי֙ לֻחֹ֣ת אֲבָנִ֔ים וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֖ם אֵלָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: These words spoke Yahweh to all your assembly on the mountain from [the] midst of the fire, the cloud and the thick darkness, [with] a voice great, and not he added; and he wrote them on two tablets of stones and gave them to me.

en.L: These words {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} spoke to all your assembly on the mountain from the midst of the fire, the cloud, and the thick darkness, [with] a great voice, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} added no more; and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wrote them on two tablets of stone and gave them to me.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} spoke these words to your whole assembly at the mountain, in a great voice out of the fire, the cloud and the thick darkness, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said no more. He wrote them on two tablets of stone and gave them to me.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} spoke these words in a loud voice to all of you gathered at the mountain. He spoke from the fire, the cloud and the thick darkness, and then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said nothing more. He wrote the words on two tablets made of stone and gave them to me.

es.L: Estas palabras habló {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a toda {{plural_you:su asamblea|vuestra asamblea}} en el monte, de en medio del fuego, de la nube y de la densa oscuridad, [con] una gran voz, y no añadió más; y las escribió en dos tablas de piedra y me las dio.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dirigió estas palabras a toda {{plural_you:su asamblea|vuestra asamblea}} en el monte, con voz potente, desde el fuego, la nube y la densa oscuridad, y no dijo nada más. Las escribió en dos tablas de piedra y me las entregó.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo estas palabras con voz fuerte a todos {{plural_you:ustedes, que estaban reunidos|vosotros, que estabais reunidos}} junto al monte. Habló desde el fuego, la nube y la densa oscuridad, y después no dijo nada más. Escribió esas palabras en dos tablas de piedra y me las dio.

fr.L: Ces paroles, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les a dites à toute votre assemblée sur la montagne, du milieu du feu, de la nuée et de l’obscurité épaisse, [d’]une voix forte, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’a rien ajouté ; et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a écrites sur deux tables de pierre et me les a données.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a prononcé ces paroles devant toute votre assemblée, près de la montagne, d’une voix forte, du milieu du feu, de la nuée et de l’obscurité épaisse, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’a rien dit de plus. Il les a écrites sur deux tables de pierre et me les a remises.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit ces paroles d’une voix forte à vous tous qui étiez rassemblés près de la montagne. Il a parlé du milieu du feu, du nuage et de l’obscurité épaisse, puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’a plus rien dit. Il a écrit ces paroles sur deux tables de pierre et me les a données.

sw.L: Maneno haya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyanena kwa kusanyiko lenu lote mlimani kutoka katikati ya moto, wingu na giza nene, [kwa] sauti kuu, wala hakuongeza; {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akayaandika juu ya vibao viwili vya mawe, akanipa.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyasema maneno haya kwa kusanyiko lenu lote pale mlimani, kwa sauti kuu kutoka katika moto, wingu na giza zito, wala hakusema zaidi. Aliyaandika juu ya vibao viwili vya mawe, akanipa.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyasema maneno haya kwa sauti kubwa kwenu nyote mliokusanyika mlimani. Alisema kutoka katika moto, wingu na giza nene, kisha hakusema kitu kingine. Aliyaandika maneno hayo juu ya vibao viwili vya mawe, akanipa.

ko.L: 이 말씀들을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 산 위 불과 구름과 흑암 가운데서 큰 소리로 너희 온 회중에게 말씀하시고, 더하지 않으셨다. 그리고 그분께서 그것을 두 돌판에 쓰셔서 나에게 주셨다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 산 위에서 불과 구름과 짙은 흑암 가운데서 큰 소리로 너희 온 회중에게 이 말씀을 하시고, 더 이상 아무 말씀도 하지 않으셨다. 그리고 그 말씀을 두 돌판에 쓰셔서 나에게 주셨다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 산에 모인 여러분 모두에게 큰 소리로 이 말씀을 하셨습니다. 그분께서는 불과 구름과 짙은 흑암 속에서 말씀하셨고, 그다음에는 아무 말씀도 더 하지 않으셨습니다. 그분께서는 그 말씀을 두 개의 돌판에 쓰셔서 저에게 주셨습니다.

vi.L: Những lời này {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán với toàn thể hội của các ngươi trên núi, từ giữa lửa, mây và mây dày đặc, [bằng] tiếng lớn, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không thêm gì nữa; và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} viết chúng trên hai bảng đá và trao cho tôi.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán những lời này với toàn thể hội chúng anh em trên núi, bằng một tiếng lớn từ giữa lửa, mây và mây đen dày đặc, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không phán thêm gì nữa. Ngài viết các lời ấy trên hai bảng đá và trao cho tôi.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán những lời này với tiếng lớn cho tất cả anh em đang nhóm lại dưới núi. Ngài phán từ trong lửa, mây và mây đen dày đặc, rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không phán gì thêm nữa. Ngài viết những lời ấy trên hai bảng bằng đá và trao cho tôi.

pt.L: Estas palavras {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} falou a toda a assembleia de vocês no monte, do meio do fogo, da nuvem e da escuridão densa, [com] grande voz, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não acrescentou [mais nada]; e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} as escreveu em duas tábuas de pedra e as deu a mim.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} falou estas palavras a toda a assembleia de vocês, no monte, com voz forte, do meio do fogo, da nuvem e da densa escuridão, e não disse mais nada. Ele as escreveu em duas tábuas de pedra e as entregou a mim.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} falou estas palavras em voz alta a todos vocês, reunidos junto ao monte. Ele falou do meio do fogo, da nuvem e da escuridão densa, e depois não disse mais nada. Ele escreveu as palavras em duas tábuas de pedra e as entregou a mim.

am.L: እነዚህን ቃሎች {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በተራራው ላይ ከእሳቱ፣ ከደመናውና ከድቅድቅ ጨለማው መካከል በታላቅ ድምፅ ለጉባኤያችሁ ሁሉ ተናገረ፤ ከዚህም በላይ አልጨመረም፤ በሁለት የድንጋይ ጽላቶችም ላይ ጻፋቸው፤ ለእኔም ሰጠኝ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እነዚህን ቃሎች በተራራው ላይ ከእሳቱ፣ ከደመናውና ከድቅድቅ ጨለማው ውስጥ በታላቅ ድምፅ ለጉባኤያችሁ ሁሉ ተናገረ፤ ከዚያም ሌላ ምንም አልጨመረም። በሁለት የድንጋይ ጽላቶች ላይ ጽፎ ሰጠኝ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እነዚህን ቃሎች በተራራው አጠገብ ለተሰበሰባችሁት ለሁላችሁ በታላቅ ድምፅ ተናገረ። ከእሳቱ፣ ከደመናውና ከድቅድቅ ጨለማው ውስጥ ተናገረ፤ ከዚያ በኋላ ሌላ ምንም አልተናገረም። ቃሎቹንም በሁለት የድንጋይ ጽላቶች ላይ ጽፎ ሰጠኝ።

hi.L: ये वचन {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने पहाड़ पर आग, बादल और घोर अंधकार के बीच में से तुम्हारी सारी सभा से ऊँचे शब्द से कहे, और और कुछ न जोड़ा; और उन्होंने उन्हें पत्थर की दो पटियाओं पर लिखकर मुझे दे दिया।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने ये वचन पहाड़ पर तुम्हारी सारी सभा से आग, बादल और घोर अंधकार में से ऊँचे शब्द से कहे, और इसके सिवा और कुछ नहीं कहा। उन्होंने उन्हें पत्थर की दो पटियाओं पर लिखकर मुझे दे दिया।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने पहाड़ के पास इकट्ठे हुए तुम सब से ये बातें ऊँची आवाज़ में कहीं। वे आग, बादल और घने अंधकार में से बोले, और फिर उन्होंने और कुछ नहीं कहा। उन्होंने ये बातें पत्थर की दो पटियाओं पर लिखकर मुझे दे दीं।

ru.L: Эти слова говорил {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} всему вашему собранию на горе из среды огня, облака и мрака громким голосом, и больше не прибавил; и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} написал их на двух каменных скрижалях и дал их мне.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал эти слова всему вашему собранию у горы громким голосом из огня, облака и густого мрака, и больше {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} ничего не сказал. Он написал их на двух каменных скрижалях и дал их мне.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} громким голосом сказал эти слова всем вам, собравшимся у горы. Он говорил из огня, облака и густого мрака, а потом больше ничего не сказал. Он написал эти слова на двух каменных скрижалях и дал их мне.

uk.L: Ці слова говорив {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} всьому вашому зібранню на горі з-посеред вогню, хмари і мороку, великим голосом, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} нічого не додав; і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} написав їх на двох камʼяних таблицях і дав їх мені.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} проголосив ці слова всьому вашому зібранню біля гори могутнім голосом із вогню, хмари й густого мороку, і більше {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} нічого не сказав. Він написав їх на двох камʼяних таблицях і дав мені.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав ці слова гучним голосом усім вам, що зібралися біля гори. Він говорив із вогню, хмари й густої темряви, а потім більше нічого не сказав. Він написав ці слова на двох камʼяних таблицях і дав їх мені.

decisions.choice: and he added no more: these words and nothing else
alternatives: and he did not stop speaking
decisions.reason: God spoke the ten words to the whole people and then spoke no further words to them directly. The rest of the law came through Moses (verses 27-31). The ten words therefore stand apart from all the other laws. An old Aramaic rendering took the phrase as "and he did not stop", that is, God's voice never ceased; the plain sense of the Hebrew here is "he added no more".

decisions.choice: two tablets of stone: the covenant written by God
decisions.reason: God wrote the ten words on two stone tablets and gave them to Moses (4:13; 9:10; Exodus 24:12; 31:18). Chapters 9-10 tell how the tablets were broken and written again (10:1-5).

decisions.choice: thick darkness: a dense, dark cloud
decisions.reason: The word names the deep, dark cloud in which God was hidden on the mountain (4:11; Exodus 20:21).

decisions.choice: assembly: the people gathered as one body
decisions.reason: The word names Israel gathered before God. Deuteronomy calls this "the day of the assembly" (9:10; 10:4; 18:16).

decisions.choice: split into sentences
decisions.reason: Readable splits the long verse into short sentences and repeats "He spoke"; it says "all of you gathered" for "your assembly".

decisions.choice: "hội" (L); "hội chúng" (B) for the assembly
decisions.reason: The people gathered as one body (meaning decision); "hội" is the term sheet's word for qahal, and Balanced uses the fuller "hội chúng" for a gathering of the whole people.

decisions.choice: "회중" for the assembly
decisions.reason: The term sheet keeps "총회" for qahal as a formal gathering; here the whole people stand at the mountain as one body, which the Korean Exodus calls "회중". Uncertain: a reviewer may prefer "총회" to keep the Hebrew word distinct.

decisions.choice: "собрание"
decisions.reason: For the whole of Deuteronomy, as the Pentateuch note settles: qahal, the people gathered as one body (m4), is "собрание"; ʿedah is "община". ¦

source.text: וַיְהִ֗י כְּשָׁמְעֲכֶ֤ם אֶת־הַקּוֹל֙ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַחֹ֔שֶׁךְ וְהָהָ֖ר בֹּעֵ֣ר בָּאֵ֑שׁ וַתִּקְרְב֣וּן אֵלַ֔י כָּל־רָאשֵׁ֥י שִׁבְטֵיכֶ֖ם וְזִקְנֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was, when you heard the voice from [the] midst of the darkness, and the mountain [was] burning with fire, and you drew near to me, all [the] heads of your tribes and your elders,

en.L: And it happened, when you heard the voice from the midst of the darkness, and the mountain [was] burning with fire, that you came near to me, all the heads of your tribes and your elders,
en.B: When you heard the voice coming out of the darkness and the mountain was burning with fire, all your tribal heads and your elders came near to me,
en.R: You heard the voice from the darkness, and you saw the mountain burning with fire. Then all the leaders of your tribes and your elders came to me.

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando {{plural_you:oyeron|oísteis}} la voz de en medio de las tinieblas, y el monte [estaba] ardiendo en fuego, {{plural_you:se acercaron|os acercasteis}} a mí, todos los jefes de {{plural_you:sus tribus|vuestras tribus}} y {{plural_you:sus ancianos|vuestros ancianos}},
es.B: Cuando {{plural_you:oyeron|oísteis}} la voz que salía de la oscuridad, mientras el monte ardía en llamas, todos los jefes de {{plural_you:sus tribus|vuestras tribus}} y {{plural_you:sus ancianos|vuestros ancianos}} se acercaron a mí,
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes oyeron|Vosotros oísteis}} la voz que venía de la oscuridad y {{plural_you:vieron|visteis}} el monte ardiendo en llamas. Entonces todos los jefes de {{plural_you:sus tribus|vuestras tribus}} y {{plural_you:sus ancianos|vuestros ancianos}} vinieron a verme.

fr.L: Et il est arrivé, quand vous avez entendu la voix du milieu des ténèbres, et que la montagne [était] brûlante de feu, que vous vous êtes approchés de moi, tous les chefs de vos tribus et vos anciens,
fr.B: Quand vous avez entendu la voix qui sortait des ténèbres, alors que la montagne brûlait de feu, tous les chefs de vos tribus et vos anciens se sont approchés de moi,
fr.R: Vous avez entendu la voix qui venait de l’obscurité, et vous avez vu la montagne en feu. Alors tous les chefs de vos tribus et vos anciens sont venus me trouver.

sw.L: Ikawa, mlipoisikia sauti kutoka katikati ya giza, mlima [ulipokuwa] ukiwaka moto, mkanikaribia, wakuu wote wa makabila yenu na wazee wenu,
sw.B: Mlipoisikia sauti ikitoka katika giza, mlima ulipokuwa ukiwaka moto, wakuu wote wa makabila yenu na wazee wenu walinikaribia,
sw.R: Mliisikia sauti kutoka gizani, na mkaona mlima ukiwaka moto. Kisha viongozi wote wa makabila yenu na wazee wenu wakanijia.

ko.L: 그리고 너희가 어둠 가운데서 나오는 그 소리를 들었고, 산은 불로 타오르고 있었을 때에, 너희 지파의 모든 우두머리와 너희 장로들이 나에게 가까이 와서,
ko.B: 너희가 어둠 가운데서 들려오는 그 목소리를 듣고, 산이 불로 타오르고 있을 때, 너희 지파의 모든 우두머리와 장로들이 나에게 와서,
ko.R: 여러분은 어둠 속에서 들려오는 그 목소리를 들었고, 산이 불로 타오르는 것을 보았습니다. 그때 여러분 지파의 모든 지도자와 장로들이 저에게 왔습니다.

vi.L: Và khi các ngươi nghe tiếng từ giữa bóng tối, và núi đang cháy bừng lửa, thì các ngươi đến gần tôi, tất cả những người đứng đầu các chi tộc của các ngươi và các trưởng lão của các ngươi,
vi.B: Khi anh em nghe tiếng phán từ trong bóng tối, và núi đang bốc cháy, thì tất cả những người đứng đầu các chi tộc và các trưởng lão của anh em đến gần tôi,
vi.R: Anh em đã nghe tiếng phán từ trong bóng tối, và thấy núi đang bốc cháy. Bấy giờ tất cả những người lãnh đạo các chi tộc và các trưởng lão của anh em đến gặp tôi.

pt.L: E aconteceu que, quando vocês ouviram a voz do meio da escuridão, e o monte [estava] ardendo em fogo, vocês se aproximaram de mim, todos os chefes das tribos de vocês e os anciãos de vocês,
pt.B: Quando vocês ouviram a voz que saía da escuridão, enquanto o monte ardia em fogo, todos os chefes das tribos de vocês e os anciãos de vocês se aproximaram de mim,
pt.R: Vocês ouviram a voz que vinha da escuridão e viram o monte ardendo em fogo. Então todos os líderes das tribos de vocês e os anciãos de vocês vieram até mim.

am.L: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ድምፁን ከጨለማው መካከል በሰማችሁ ጊዜ፣ ተራራውም በእሳት ሲነድ፣ እናንተ፣ የነገዶቻችሁ አለቆች ሁሉና ሽማግሌዎቻችሁ፣ ወደ እኔ ቀረባችሁ፤
am.B: ድምፁ ከጨለማው ውስጥ ሲወጣ በሰማችሁና ተራራው በእሳት ሲነድ፣ የነገዶቻችሁ አለቆች ሁሉና ሽማግሌዎቻችሁ ወደ እኔ ቀረባችሁ፤
